title: White House construction project to cost almost $1bn
english: The Trump administration is facing scrutiny after reports revealed plans to spend nearly $1 billion on White House construction, including a new ballroom. Officials defend the project as a necessary security measure coordinated with the Secret Service. However, critics and lawmakers are concerned that the heavy reliance on private donations could lead to conflicts of interest.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኋይት ሀውስ ለግንባታ ስራዎች ወደ አንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር ሊያወጣ መሆኑ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል። አስተዳደሩ ፕሮጀክቱ ለፕሬዝዳንቱ ደህንነት ሲባል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ የሚገልጽ ሲሆን፥ የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት አባላት ግን በግል ለጋሾች የሚደረገው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የጥቅም ግጭት ሊፈጥር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Trump mana mootummaa (White House) haaromsuuf doolara biliyoona tokko ga'u baasuuf karoorfachuu isaa hordofee mormiin ka'eera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa hojiin kun nageenya prezidantichaa mirkaneessuuf barbaachisaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, gargaarsi namoota dhuunfaa irraa argamu kun walitti bu'iinsa faayidaa uumuu danda'a jedhanii shakkuun ka'eera.

title: Major Russian grain export terminal hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
english: A significant Ukrainian drone and missile attack has damaged Russian grain export facilities and a major naval base in the port city of Novorossiysk. The assault resulted in several civilian casualties and forced Russia to divert its cargo shipments to other transport routes. President Zelensky stated that Ukrainian forces are targeting Russian military infrastructure to weaken the ongoing occupation.

oromo: Ukraynan magaalatti doonii Novorosiyeesk irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee fi misayilii gaggeessiteen, bakkeewwan midhaan alatti erganii fi buufanni waraanaa Ruusiyaa miidhamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni lubbuun darban yoo ta'u, miidhaan biroo irra ga'ee jira; kunis Ruusiyaan fe'umsa midhaanii gara karaa biraatti akka geessitu dirqisiiseera. Pirezidaantiin Ukraynaa Volodimir Zeeleniskii, haleellaan kun bu'uuraalee misooma waraanaa Ruusiyaa laaffisuuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Drought exposes Nazi-era warship wrecks beneath the Danube
english: Severe drought conditions in Europe have caused water levels in the Danube River near Serbia to drop significantly. This drop has revealed dozens of sunken warships left behind by Nazi forces during their retreat in 1944. These historical vessels, which had been hidden underwater for decades, are now visible due to the record-low water levels.
amharic: በአውሮፓ እየተከሰተ ያለው የከፋ ድርቅ በሰርቢያ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘው የዳኑብ ወንዝ ውሃ መጠን እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ይህ የውሃ መመናመን በ1944 ዓ.ም የናዚ ጦር እያፈገፈገ በነበረበት ወቅት ሰጥመው የነበሩ በርካታ የጦር መርከቦችን ገጽታ አጋልጧል። እነዚህ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት በውሃ ውስጥ ተሰውረው የነበሩ ታሪካዊ መርከቦች አሁን በታየው ከፍተኛ የውሃ መጉደል ምክንያት ሊታዩ ችለዋል።
oromo: Hanga dhahataa (drought) cimaa Awurooppaa keessatti muudateen lagni Daanuub naannoo Serbiyaa keessatti dhangala'uun isaa baay'ee gad xiqqaateera. Hir'inni bishaanii kun, bara 1944 yeroo loltoonni Naazii duubatti deebi'aa turanitti markaboota lolaa bishaan keessatti liqimsaman hedduu ifa baaseera. Markaboonni seena-qabeeyyiin waggoota hedduuf bishaan jala dhokatee turan kun, gadi bu'iinsa bishaan sadarkaa seenaa irra gahe kana hordofee mul'achuu danda'aniiru.

title: Trump remarks on diminishing impact of pro-Israel groups in Congress
english: President Donald Trump recently stated that pro-Israel lobbying groups have significantly lost their traditional influence in Washington compared to two decades ago. During a media interview, he noted a major shift in political sentiment, particularly among Democrats in the House of Representatives. Recent polls confirm this trend, showing declining support for Israel within both the Democratic Party and sections of the Republican base.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ እንደገለጹት እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ የሎቢ ቡድኖች ከሃያ ዓመታት በፊት የነበራቸውን ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አጥተዋል። በአንድ ሚዲያ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ በተለይም በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለው የፖለቲካ አቋም ለውጥ በጣም አስገራሚ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናቶችም ይህንን አዝማሚያ የሚያረጋግጡ ሲሆን፣ በእስራኤል ላይ ያለው የድጋፍ መጠን በሁለቱም ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ውስጥ እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Donald Traamp akka dubbatanitti, gareewwan Israa'el deggeran kunneen amansiisuu irratti dhiibbaa waggaa 20 dura qaban amma dhabaniiru. Gaaffii fi deebii miidiyaa irratti akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun keessattuu miseensota paartii Dimokraatawaa gidduutti kan mul'atu ta'uu dubbataniiru. Qorannoowwan amansiisoonis deggersi Israa'eliif qaban lamaan isaaniyyuu keessattuu paartilee siyaasaa gurguddoo keessatti hir'achaa dhufuu isaanii mirkaneessu.

title: LA Lakers to be sold in record $12.5bn deal
english: The Los Angeles Lakers are set to be purchased for a record-breaking $12.5 billion. The controlling interest in the team will be acquired by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger. This agreement follows the majority stake acquisition by Mark Walter less than a year ago.
amharic: የሎስ አንጀለስ ሌከርስ የቅርጫት ኳስ ቡድን በሪከርድ በሆነ 12.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ሊሸጥ ነው። ቡድኑን የሚገዙት ጆሽ ኩሽነር እና የቀድሞው የዲስኒ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ቦብ አይገር ናቸው። ይህ ስምምነት የተፈረመው ማርክ ዋልተር አብላጫ ድርሻውን ከተቆጣጠረ ከአንድ ዓመት ባነሰ ጊዜ ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: gareen kubbaa darbannoo Los Angeles Lakers gatii seena qabeessa ta'e biliyoona 12.5 gurguramuuf qophaa'aa jira. Bitattoonni kunis Josh Kushner fi hojii gaggeessaan duraanii Walt Disney Bob Iger dha. Walii galteen kun Mark Walter hirmaannaa guddaa isaa erga fudhate waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: PSG vs Aston Villa LIVE: UEFA Super Cup 2026
english: Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa are competing in the 2026 UEFA Super Cup to mark the start of the European football season. The match is being held at the Salzburg Stadium in Austria. Kickoff is scheduled for 9:00 PM local time.
amharic: የፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን እና የአስቶን ቪላ ቡድኖች የአውሮፓ የእግር ኳስ የውድድር ዘመን መጀመርያ በሆነው የ2026 ዩኢኤፍኤ (UEFA) ሱፐር ካፕ ላይ ይፋለማሉ። ጨዋታው በኦስትሪያ ሳልዝበርግ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ የመክፈቻው ሰዓትም ምሽት 3 ሰዓት ላይ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Pariis Saint-Jeermeen fi Astoon Viilaa jalqaba sagantaa kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa kan ta'e, qophii 2026 UEFA Super Cup irratti walmorkatu. Taphi kun istaadiyoomii Saalzberg kan Awustiriyaa keessatti kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, sa'aatiin isaas galgala sa'aatii sagal irratti kan eegalamu dha.

title: Europe prepares for first total solar eclipse in 27 years
english: Europe is getting ready for a total solar eclipse, the first one the continent has experienced in nearly three decades. A massive number of people are expected to watch the phenomenon as it moves through a path stretching from Iceland down to Spain. Researchers are utilizing specialized aircraft and observatories to document this rare astronomical event.
amharic: አውሮፓ በቅርቡ የሚከሰተውንና በሃያ ሰባት ዓመት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሚታየውን ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ለመመልከት እየተዘጋጀች ነው። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ከኢስላንድ እስከ ስፔን በሚዘልቀው የግርዶሹ መስመር ላይ በመሰባሰብ ይህንን ያልተለመደ ክስተት ለመታዘብ ይጠበቃሉ። ሳይንቲስቶችም ይህንን ብርቅዬ የጠፈር ክስተት ለመመዝገብ ልዩ አውሮፕላኖችንና የጠፈር መመልከቻዎችን እያሰማሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Awurooppaan waggoota digdamii torba keessatti markii jalqabaaf kan mul'atu guutuu tirii aduu ilaaluuf qophii gochaa jirti. Namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman Iislandii irraa hanga Ispeenitti daandii tirii aduun kun itti mul'atu irratti walga'anii raajii kana arguuf eeggachaa jiru. Qorattoonniis taatee kana qoratanii galmeessuuf xiyyaarotaa fi meeshaalee qilleensa irraa raajii kana hordofan qopheeffachaa jiru.

title: Colombia declares three days of mourning after deadly earthquake
english: Colombia has announced three days of national mourning following a massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake that claimed over 200 lives in the western part of the country. Rescue teams are currently working around the clock to find survivors trapped under debris, while thousands remain missing or injured. This disaster marks the first significant challenge for President Abelardo de la Espriella, who assumed office only days before the catastrophe occurred.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ ከባድ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከ200 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ ሀገሪቱ የሶስት ቀናት ብሔራዊ የሀዘን ቀን አውጇል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠመዱ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ጥረት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። ይህ አደጋ በቅርቡ ስልጣን በያዙት ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ ላይ የተጋረጠ የመጀመሪያው ከባድ ፈተና ሆኗል።
oromo: Kolombiyaan gadoojii biyyoolessaa guyyaa sadii kan labsite yoo ta'u, kunis raafama lafaa cimaa hanga 7.4 ga'uun namoota 200 ol ajjeesuusaatiin kan dhufedha. Gareen gargaarsaa iddoo raafamichi itti hammaatetti namoota diigama jala jiran baasuuf halkanii guyyaa hojjachaa jiru, namootni kumaan lakkaa'aman ammoo bakki buuteensaanii hin beekamu. Balaan kun pirezidaantii haaraa aangoo qabatanii guyyoota muraasa keessatti isaan qunname waan ta'eef, qormaata guddaa isaanii jalqabaati.

title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
english: Russia's economy is showing signs of instability as a growing budget deficit and ongoing Ukrainian military strikes put pressure on its financial health. While rising global energy prices tied to Middle East conflicts have provided unexpected revenue, the nation's growth rate is expected to drop significantly. The United States is now attempting to further restrict Moscow's profits by imposing heavy tariffs on its energy buyers.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የበጀት ጉድለት እና በዩክሬን ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቋል። ምንም እንኳን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ ዋጋን በመጨመር ለሩሲያ ተጨማሪ ገቢ ቢያስገኝም፣ የአገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዕድገት ግን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀንስ ይጠበቃል። አሜሪካም የሩሲያ የነዳጅ ገዢዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ቀረጥ በመጣል የሞስኮን ገቢ ለመቀነስ እየሞከረች ነው።

title: WHO chief says Trump vaccine push goes against ‘decades of evidence’
english: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has criticized President Donald Trump’s recent efforts to overhaul childhood vaccination policies, including calls to split the MMR vaccine. Tedros emphasized that decades of scientific research consistently prove vaccines are safe and do not cause autism, contrary to claims promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The WHO chief warned that delaying or separating doses lacks medical justification and risks leaving children vulnerable to preventable diseases.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ቴዎድሮስ አድሓኖም የፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የልጆች ክትባቶችን ለመቀየር የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት ተቹ። ዶክተር ቴዎድሮስ የጤና ሚኒስትሩ ሮበርት ኤፍ ኬኔዲ ጁኒየር የሚያራምዱት የክትባትና የኦቲዝም ትስስር ሳይንሳዊ መሠረት የሌለው መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ክትባቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የክትባት መርሃ ግብሮችን ያለ አግባብ ማዘግየት ወይም መከፋፈል ለህጻናት የጤና አደጋ እንደሚፈጥርም ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa Dr. Teediroos Adhaanoom, yaalii pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp imaammata kantaabbii ijoollee irratti jijjiirama gochuuf taasisaa jiran balaaleffataniiru. Dr. Teediroos, ministeerri fayyaa Roobert Ef. Keenedi Junaayar qoricha MMR fi autizimii gidduu walitti dhufeenyi jira jechuun dubbatan ragaa saayinsii kan hin qabneefi soba ta'uu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, kantaabbiiwwan hundi fayyummaa kan qaban ta'uu mirkaneessuun, kantaabbii yeroo isaa eeggate gara boodatti harkisuun ykn gargar baasuun ijoollee dhibee ittifamuu danda'uuf akka saaxilu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
english: Last month, President Donald Trump secretly switched aircraft in Turkey to avoid a potential security threat from Iran, leaving a decoy plane behind. While Trump departed on a separate military flight, key cabinet members like Marco Rubio and Scott Bessent stayed on the original plane to ensure a clear line of succession if an emergency occurred. The President stated that the military and Secret Service orchestrated this deception to ensure his safety during his travels.
amharic: ባለፈው ወር ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ሊመጣ የሚችል የደህንነት ስጋትን ለመከላከል በቱርክ ውስጥ በሚስጥር ሌላ አውሮፕላን ተጠቅመዋል። ትራምፕ በሌላ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ሲጓዙ፣ እንደ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ እና ስኮት ቤሰንት ያሉ የካቢኔ አባላት ግን የመጀመሪያው አውሮፕላን ላይ በመቆየት የአመራር መተካካት ሂደቱን አስተማማኝ አድርገውታል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው በወታደራዊ እና በደህንነት አካላት ትዕዛዝ ደህንነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ji'a darbe keessa, pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraampis soda nageenyaa Iraan irraa dhufee mala qindaa'een daandii qilleensaa kan biraatti dabraniru. Tiraampis xiyyaara waraanaa biraatiin yommuu imalan, miseensonni kaabinee isaa kanneen akka Maarko Ruubiyoo fi Skootti Beesentii xiyyaara duraanii irratti hafuun, yoo rakkoon uumame tartiiba aangoo eeguuf gumaachaniiru. Pirezidaantichi tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame ajaja humna waraanaa fi tikaa biyyattii tiin nageenya isaanii eeguuf akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
english: Severe drought has caused water levels in the Danube River to drop, exposing the remains of two German World War II soldiers and their motorcycle. Along with the bodies, investigators recovered personal identification tags, military badges, and unexploded anti-tank mines near Budapest. Experts are now working to identify the individuals to finally provide closure to their long-waiting families.
amharic: በዳኑቤ ወንዝ ላይ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ ድርቅ የውሃ መጠን እንዲቀንስ በማድረጉ፣ የሁለት የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት የጀርመን ወታደሮች አስከሬን እና ሞተር ሳይክል እንዲገኙ አስችሏል። በቡዳፔስት ከተማ አቅራቢያ ከተገኙት አስከሬኖች ጋር የመታወቂያ ሰሌዳዎች፣ ወታደራዊ የክብር ምልክቶች እና ያልፈነዱ ፈንጂዎች ተገኝተዋል። የጀርመን የጦር መቃብር ኮሚሽን እነዚህን ግለሰቦች ለመለየት እና ከረጅም ጊዜ በኋላ ለቤተሰቦቻቸው መረጃ ለመስጠት ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Gogiinsi cimaan laga Daaniub irratti uumame sadarkaa bishaanicha gad-buusuun, reeffa waraanaa Jarmanii waraana Addunyaa lammaffaa keessatti du'anii fi mootarsaykilicha akka bahu godheera. Reefficha biratti meeshaaleen eenyummee ibsan, mallattoolee waraanaa fi meeshaaleen waraana kan hin dhoone magaalatti magaalaa Budaapest biratti argamaniiru. Komishiniin awwaala waraanaa Jarmanii, namoota kunneen eenyummeessuun maatii isaanii kan waggoota dheeraaf eegaa turanitti odeeffannoo kennuuf qorannoo eegaleera.

title: US consumer inflation slows in July as energy prices briefly retreat
english: US consumer inflation grew at a slower rate in July due to a temporary dip in energy costs. Despite this brief relief, fuel prices remain significantly higher than they were a year ago, largely due to ongoing shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Alongside rising prices, the economy is also facing challenges with recent job losses in sectors like retail and education.
amharic: በሀምሌ ወር የነዳጅ ዋጋ በጊዜያዊነት በመቀነሱ በአሜሪካ የሸማቾች የዋጋ ግሽበት መጠን ቀንሷል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ለውጥ ቢኖርም፣ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እየተፈጠረ ባለው የትራንስፖርት መስተጓጎል ምክንያት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከአምናው አንጻር አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል። ከዚህ የዋጋ ንረት በተጨማሪ፣ እንደ ችርቻሮ እና ትምህርት ባሉ ዘርፎች የስራ ዕድል መቀነስ በአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጫና እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ji'a July keessa gatiin boba'aa yeroof gadi hir'achuun isaa gatiin gabaa irratti dabaluun isaa xiqqoo akka tasgabbaa'u godheera. Gatiin boba'aa yeroof hir'atuus, rakkoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti uumamee jiruun gatiin isaa kan waggaa darbee wajjin yoo madaalamu ammas baay'ee olka'aa dha. Gatiin gabaa dabaluu irra darbee, hoji dhabdummaan sektaroota akka daldalaa fi barnoota keessatti mul'achuu isaa qooda fudhachuun dinagdee Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: As Strait of Hormuz transit drops, Trump again says US has ‘control’
english: President Donald Trump claims the United States maintains complete authority over the Strait of Hormuz despite a significant decline in maritime traffic. Currently, only eight ships are passing through the waterway daily compared to over 130 before the US-Israel war with Iran. Meanwhile, peace negotiations have stalled as Iran refuses to restore normal shipping until sanctions are removed and the US naval blockade ends.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረገው የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቢቀንስም፣ አሜሪካ በቦታው ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት ተናግረዋል። ከኢራን ጋር በተደረገው ጦርነት ሳቢያ በየቀኑ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር ከነበረው 130 ወደ ስምንት ዝቅ ብሏል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ኢራን ማዕቀቦች እስኪነሱ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳው እስኪያበቃ ድረስ መደበኛ እንቅስቃሴ እንደማይኖር በመግለጿ የሰላም ንግግሮች ተስተጓጉለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidanti Doonald Tiraamp, naannoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti adeemsi markabootaa hedduu gadi bu'us, Ameerikaan guutummaatti to'annoo ishee jala akka jiru ibsaniiru. Waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kan Iran waliin taasifameen walqabatee, duraan guyyaatti markaboota 130 ol darban turan amma gara saddeetiitti gadi bu'aniiru. Gama biraan, Iran hanga gumaachi irraa ka'uu fi daandiin galaana sun banamutti mariin nagaa akka hin milkoofne waan ibsiteef, haalli naannichaa ammas xaxamaa ta'ee jira.

title: Lebanon passes long-sought amnesty law, a day after death penalty repeal
english: Lebanon has officially passed a general amnesty law, the first of its kind since 1991, to help address severe prison overcrowding. The new legislation reduces various prison terms and provides for the release of detainees who have been held for long periods without being charged. While supporters believe this will reform the justice system, some families of victims are concerned that those who committed serious violence may be released too easily.
amharic: ሊባኖስ በእስር ቤቶች ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ መጨናነቅ ለመቅረፍ ከ1991 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የወጣ አጠቃላይ የምህረት አዋጅ አጽድቃለች። ይህ አዲስ ህግ አንዳንድ የእስር ጊዜዎችን የሚቀንስ ሲሆን፣ ያለ ክስ ለረጅም ጊዜ የታሰሩ እስረኞችንም ለመልቀቅ መንገድ ይከፍታል። የህጉ ደጋፊዎች የፍትህ ስርዓቱን ለማሻሻል ይረዳል ብለው ሲያምኑ፣ አንዳንድ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ግን ከባድ ወንጀል የፈጸሙ ሰዎች ያለ አግባብ ሊፈቱ ይችላሉ በሚል ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Libanoon guutumaa biyyattii keessatti baay'ina mana hidhaa hir'isuuf jecha, bara 1991 asitti kan hin mul'anne seera dhiifamaa waliigalaa raggaasisteetti. Seerri haaraan kun yeroo hidhaa garii kan gabaabsu ta'uun, namoota utuu himanni irratti hin dhiyaatin yeroo dheeraaf hidhamanii turan gadhiisuuf gargaara. Hordoftoonni seera kanaa sirna haqaa fooyyessuuf bu'a qabeessa ta'uu isaa kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, maatiin namoota miidhamanii tokko tokko garuu, namoonni yakka cimaa raawwatan haqa malee gadhiifamu jedhanii sodaachaa jiru.

title: Why the UK faces a prisons crisis amid row over release of cop killers
english: The UK is facing a major prison overcrowding crisis, leading the government to introduce a scheme that allows prisoners to be released after serving only one-third of their sentences. Prime Minister Andy Burnham faced significant public backlash after it was revealed that this policy might apply to the killers of Police Constable Andrew Harper. In response, the government has delayed the program and excluded certain violent offenders from eligibility to address safety concerns.
amharic: ዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በከባድ የእስር ቤት መጨናነቅ ችግር ውስጥ በመሆኗ መንግስት እስረኞች የቅጣታቸውን አንድ ሶስተኛ ብቻ ካጠናቀቁ በኋላ እንዲለቀቁ የሚያደርግ እቅድ አውጥቷል። ይሁን እንጂ የፖሊስ ኮንስታብል አንድሪው ሃርፐር ገዳዮች በዚህ እቅድ ተጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ሲሰማ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ተቀስቅሷል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ለመስጠት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የፕሮግራሙን አፈጻጸም ያዘገዩ ሲሆን፣ ለደህንነት ሲባል አንዳንድ አደገኛ ወንጀለኞችን ከዚህ እቅድ ውጪ አድርገዋል።
oromo: UK rakkoo mana hidhaa cufaa ta'ee fi namootaan guutameen walqabatee, hidhamtoonni yeroo itti murtaa'e keessaa harka sadii keessaa tokko qofa erga xumuranii booda gadhiifamuu akka danda'an sirna haaraa diriirsiteetti. Haa ta'u malee, ajjeechaa poolisii Andrew Harper irratti hirmaatanis sirna kanaan gadhiifamuu danda'uun mormii uummata cimaa kaaseera. Kana hordofee, Ministirri Muummee Andy Burnham hojiirra oolmaa sirnichaa gara boodatti kan dabarsan yoo ta'u, nageenya mirkaneessuuf jecha yakka cimaa hojjatan tokko tokko fayyadamtoota sirnichaa keessaa hambisaniiru.

title: Iran is not anti-imperialist. It is a state calculating survival
english: Despite its aggressive anti-Western rhetoric, Iran's foreign policy is primarily driven by the need to ensure the regime's survival rather than strict adherence to ideology. The Iranian government has historically shown a willingness to compromise its official stance when necessary to protect the state, as established by the constitutional principle of prioritizing regime preservation above all else. Consequently, analysts suggest that Tehran remains open to reaching a settlement with the United States and Israel if it serves their long-term security.

title: Iran's new Security Council shake-up reveals growing divisions over US deal
english: Iran's recent agreement with the United States has caused significant internal conflict within the country's Supreme National Security Council. Although the new security chief, Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, supported the deal, his stance angered hardline factions who were expecting opposition. This development highlights deep disagreements among Iranian leaders regarding diplomatic engagement with Washington.

Taateen kun marii diippilomaasii waashingtanii waliin taasifamu irratti hogganoota Iraan gidduutti wal dhabdee cimaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Trump says US will keep 'total control' of Strait of Hormuz
english: Donald Trump recently declared that the United States maintains complete authority over the Strait of Hormuz. He emphasized that the U.S. Navy has established a powerful blockade in the region, which he described as an impenetrable wall. The former president indicated his firm intention to sustain this military presence despite any opposition from Iran.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት በቅርቡ ተናግረዋል። የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል በአካባቢው ጠንካራ መከላከያ እንደዘረጋና ይህም እንደማይበገር አክለዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ከኢራን ተቃውሞ ቢኖርም ይህንን ወታደራዊ መገኘት ለመቀጠል ቁርጠኛ እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Doonaald Traamp dhiheenya kana akka jedhanitti, Yuunaayitid Isteetsi daandii galaana Hormuuz irratti to'annoo guutuu qabdi. Raayyaan galaana Ameerikaa naannichatti humna ittisaa cimaa ijaaruun isaa fi kunis kan hin cabne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Preezidaantichi duraanii kun mormii Iiraan irraa dhufuun alatti, waraana isaanii naannicha keessatti tursuuf murteeffachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Argentina star Messi not certain to play ‘much longer’ after father’s death
english: Argentine football legend Lionel Messi has suggested he may retire soon following the passing of his father, Jorge Messi. The 39-year-old athlete, who recently played in the 2026 World Cup final, expressed deep personal grief and uncertainty regarding his future in the sport. Although he remains under contract with Inter Miami, he is currently questioning whether he will continue his professional playing career.

oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataan kubbaa miilaa beekamaan Arjentiinaa Lionel Messi, du'a abbaa isaa erga ta'ee booda tapha kubbaa miilaa irraa akka dhaabu ibseera. Taphataan umrii 39 kun, qophiin tapha waancaa addunyaa bara 2026 irratti hirmaannaa erga godhee booda, miira gaddaa cimaa keessa akka jiru fi gara fuulduraatti taphachuu fi dhiisuun isaa shakkee akka jiru ibseera. Inni garee Inter Miami waliin waliigaltee kan qabu ta'us, dhimmi taphataa kun ammayyuu murtee xumuraa akka hin argatin ibsameera.

title: ‘Burn in hell’: Israeli settlers spread hate through graffiti, attacks
english: Israeli settlers are intensifying their campaign of intimidation against Palestinians in the West Bank village of Jalud by spray-painting racist, threatening slogans on homes and schools. These acts of vandalism are frequently accompanied by physical violence, including the burning of vehicles and attacks on residents. Local officials believe these actions are part of a broader, extremist strategy intended to spread terror among children and pressure the Palestinian population to flee their land.

oromo: Qotee bultoonni Israa'el qe'ee warra Palesxinaa kan ta'e baadiyaa Jalud keessatti manneen barnootaa fi mana jireenyaa irratti barreeffamoota jibbiinsaa fi sodaachisaa barreessuun rakkina babal'isuu irratti argamu. Hojjettoonni mootummaa naannichaa akka jedhanitti, garee daangaa darban kanaan kan raawwatamu gochi kun, hammeenyaa fi sodaa uumuun Palesxinaaota lafa isaanii irraa arii'uuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Sudanese army intercepts RSF drones over el-Obeid
english: The Sudanese military successfully blocked drone attacks launched by the Rapid Support Forces near the city of el-Obeid. These aircraft were spotted and neutralized by the army's air defense systems within the North Kordofan region. No further details regarding damages or injuries have been reported following the incident.

oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Sudaan magaalaa el-Obeid iratti humnoonni RSF jedhaman xiyyara nama hin feene (drones) ergan ofirraa ittiseera. Gamtaan ittisa qilleensaa kan waraanaa xiyyaroota kana bakka hubatutti dhaabsiseera. Haala kanaan walqabatee miidhaan gahuu isaa ibsi kenname hin jiru.

title: Twenty-six countries condemn in 'strongest terms' Iran executions
english: A coalition of twenty-six countries and the European Union have issued a firm statement opposing Iran's continued use of the death penalty. These nations argue that the Iranian government is executing protesters as a tactic to suppress political opposition and intimidate its citizens. They emphasized that using capital punishment to punish people for exercising their basic human rights is completely unacceptable.

oromo: Biyyoonni digdamii ja’a fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa mootummaan Iraan tarkaanfii ajjeechaa namoota irratti fudhachaa jiru jabeessee balaaleffateera. Mirga namoomaa isaanii fayyadamaniif jecha namoota irratti adabbii du'aa raawwachuun gonkumaa fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Colombia sides with Morocco over Western Sahara as it aligns with Israeli foreign policy
english: Colombia’s new far-right government has officially recognized Morocco's sovereignty over Western Sahara, reversing previous policies to align more closely with the United States and Israel. This shift includes cutting diplomatic ties with the Sahrawi independence movement and recognizing Israel's annexation of the Golan Heights. These decisions represent a significant departure from the foreign policy of the former administration, which had previously severed relations with Israel over the conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ አዲሱ የቀኝ ዘመም መንግስት የዌስተርን ሳሃራን ግዛት ሞሮኮን እንደምትቆጣጠር በይፋ አውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሀገሪቱ ከአሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ጋር ያላትን የውጭ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ሲሆን፣ የቀድሞው መንግስት ከነበረው አቋም ሙሉ በሙሉ የተለየ ነው። ኮሎምቢያ በተጨማሪም የእስራኤልን የጎላን ኮረብታዎች የመጠቅለል ውሳኔ በመደገፍ፣ ከሳህራዊ ነጻ አውጪ ግንባር ጋር የነበራትን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት አቋርጣለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Kolombiyaa haaraan mirgaa, naannoo Western Sahara irratti bulchiinsa Morookoo akka qabu beekamtii kenneera. Murteen kun biyyattiin siyaasa alaa ishee Ameerikaa fi Israa'el wajjin wal simsiisuuf kan godhamte yoo ta'u, kunis siyaasa mootummaa darbee irraa adda ta'eera. Kolombiyaan akkasumas Israa'el naannoo Golan Heights ofitti makachuu ishee kan deggertu yoo ta'u, garee bilisummaa Sahrawi waliin hariiroo dippilomaasii ishee kutteetti.

title: ‘The right to stay’: Albania’s Italian diaspora sails back to support the Flamingo Revolution
english: A group of Italian-Albanian activists and international solidarity organizations are sailing from Italy to Albania to join the Flamingo Revolution protests. This movement opposes the privatization of protected lands and luxury developments linked to foreign investors like Jared Kushner. By traveling from Puglia to Vlora, the activists are reversing the historic migration route from the 1990s to challenge the corruption they believe is currently threatening Albania's future.
amharic: የጣሊያን-አልባኒያ ተሟጋቾች እና አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች በአልባኒያ እየተካሄደ ያለውን 'ፍላሚንጎ አብዮት' ተቃውሞ ለመቀላቀል ከጣሊያን ወደ አልባኒያ በባህር ጉዞ ሊያደርጉ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የተፈጥሮ ሀብቶችን ለግል ጥቅም ማዋልን እና በውጭ ባለሀብቶች የሚደረጉ የቅንጦት ግንባታዎችን በመቃወም ላይ ያተኮረ ነው። ተሟጋቾቹ በ1990ዎቹ የነበረውን ስደት በመቀልበስ፣ ሀገሪቱን እያሰጋ ያለው የሙስና አሰራር እንዲቆም ድምፃቸውን ለማሰማት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtotni lammii Itaalii fi Albaaniyaa akkasumas gareewwan tokkummaa idil-addunyaa, mormii 'Flamingo Revolution' jedhamu deeggaruuf doonii qabatanii gara biyya Albaaniyaa deemaa jiru. Sochii kana kan kaasan lafa qulqulluu ta'e dhuunfaatti qabachuu fi invastimentii gurguddaa ala irraa dhufan mormuufidha. Hiriirtotni kun imala bara 1990 keessa godaantotni godhan faallessuun, haala amma Albaaniyaa keessatti mul'atuu fi hoggansa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa godhuuf yaadanii kan ka'aniidha.

title: Iran's new Security Council shake-up reveals growing divisions over US deal
english: Iran's security council is facing internal conflict after the new Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, publicly opposed a recent agreement with the United States. Following this, the council secretary, Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, resigned in protest, marking a rare challenge to the leader's authority. While hardliners have attacked the deal and the negotiators, President Pezeshkian had hoped to retain Zolghadr to support the government's diplomatic efforts.
amharic: የኢራን አዲሱ ጠቅላይ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የተደረሰውን ስምምነት በይፋ ከተቃወሙ በኋላ በሀገሪቱ የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ክፍፍል ተፈጥሯል። የካውንስሉ ጸሐፊ መሐመድ ባጌር ዘልጋድር ለዚህ ውሳኔ ተቃውሞ በማሰማት በገዛ ፈቃዳቸው ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጠንካራ አቋም ያላቸው ወገኖች ስምምነቱን ቢቃወሙም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ፔዜሽኪያን የዘልጋድርን መቆየት በመሻት ስምምነቱን ለማስቀጠል ጥረት አድርገው ነበር።
oromo: Iraaniin waliigaltee haaraa Ameerikaa waliin godhamaa jiru irratti hoggantoota ishee gidduutti wal dhabdee cimaatu uumame. Hogganaan olaanaa biyyattii haaraan Mojtaba Khamenei waliigaltee kana kan morman yoo ta'u, kana hordofee barreessaan koree nageenyaa biyyattii Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr mormii agarsiisuun aangoo gadi liiqeera. Gareen mormitootaa waliigaltee kana balaaleffachaa jiranis, Pirezidaanti Pezeshkiyaan garuu Zolghadr akka turan barbaaduun waliigaltee kana deeggaruuf yaalii godhaniiru.

title: 'This isn't the Britain I grew up in': The activists raided by police over Palestine Action videos
english: Many activists in the UK, including elderly citizens, are living in fear of dawn police raids for publicly supporting the banned group Palestine Action. Authorities are using counterterrorism laws to target those who have posted videos inviting support for the organization, which could lead to severe legal penalties. This crackdown has sparked concerns about civil liberties as thousands have already faced arrests for their involvement in pro-Palestine demonstrations.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ በርካታ አክቲቪስቶች፣ አረጋውያንን ጨምሮ፣ 'ፓለስታይን አክሽን' የተባለውን የተከለከለ ቡድን በይፋ በመደገፋቸው የፖሊስ ወረራ ይፈጽሙብናል በሚል ስጋት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ለቡድኑ ድጋፍ የሚያበረታቱ ቪዲዮዎችን ለለቀቁ ሰዎች ላይ የጸረ-ሽብር ህጎችን እየተጠቀሙ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ከፍተኛ የእስር ቅጣት ሊያስከትል ይችላል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በጋዛ ድጋፍ ሰልፎች ላይ በመሳተፋቸው ቀድሞውንም በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ይህ የፖሊስ እርምጃ የሰብአዊ መብቶች ጥበቃ ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: UK keessatti namoonni garee 'Palestine Action' jedhamu kan dhorgamu deggaruun isaan, poolisiin ganama barii manatti nu weerara jedhanii yaaddoo keessa jiru. Mootummaan seera farra shororkeessummaa fayyadamee namoota garee kanaaf deggarsa gaafatanirratti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jira; kunis adabbii cimaa hamma hidhaa waggaa 14 geessisuu danda'a. Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman hiriira deggarsa Palasxiinii irratti hirmaachuusaaniitiin kan qabaman yoo ta'u, tarkaanfiin kun mirga namoomaa fi bilisummaa yaadaa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
english: A 32-year-old woman named Daniela Largo was successfully rescued after being trapped under building debris for 36 hours following a massive 7.4-magnitude earthquake in Colombia. Emergency crews worked for 10 hours to reach her by digging tunnels beneath heavy concrete slabs. While this rescue has provided hope, the overall death toll from the earthquake has already reached at least 188 people, with hundreds more still missing or trapped.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የ32 ዓመቷ ዳንኤላ ላርጎ ለ36 ሰዓታት ያህል በፍርስራሽ ስር ከተቀበረች በኋላ በሕይወት ተገኝታለች። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ከባድ የኮንክሪት ንጣፎችን በዋሻ በመቆፈር የ10 ሰዓታት ጥረት በማድረግ ሴትየዋን ማውጣት ችለዋል። ይህ አድን ስራ ተስፋን የፈጠረ ቢሆንም፣ በመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የሞቱት ሰዎች ቁጥር ቢያንስ 188 የደረሰ ሲሆን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አሁንም እንደጠፉ ይገመታል።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti lafti socho'uun hanga 7.4 kan ga'u erga mudatee booda, dubartiin umriin ishee 32 kan taate Daniela Laargo jedhamtu sa'aatii 36f diigama mana jala turtee lubbuun ooteetti. Ogeessonni fayyaa fi gargaarsa ariifachiisaa sa'aatii 10 guutuu dhagaa fi konkiriiti jala bololaa harka qulleessa hojjachuun ishee baasaniiru. Gargaarsi kun abdii kan kenne ta'us, balaa kanaan namoonni 188 ol du'anii, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ammoo ammayyuu bakka buuteen isaanii akka hin beekamne gabaafameera.

title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
english: Israeli settlers have trapped two Palestinian families in their homes in the West Bank village of Qusra since Sunday, cutting off their access to food, water, and electricity. Despite pleas for help, the families remain isolated as Israeli soldiers have failed to intervene, and human rights groups are now calling for urgent military protection. This incident highlights the growing volatility in the region, which a UN official recently described as being at a breaking point.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ከእሁድ ጀምሮ በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ሁለት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን በመኖሪያ ቤታቸው ውስጥ ከበው ምግብ፣ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ እንዳያገኙ አድርገዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ እርዳታ ቢጠይቁም እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች ጣልቃ ባለመግባታቸው ቤተሰቦቹ በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ፤ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖችም አፋጣኝ ጥበቃ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ያለው አለመረጋጋት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን እና ተባብሶ መቀጠሉን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Settleeronni Israa'el Dilbata irraa eegaluun maatiiwwan Palesxinaa lama magaala Qusraa keessatti argaman manneen isaanii keessatti qabanii, nyaata, bishaan fi elektirikii irraa adda baasanii jiru. Maatiiwwan kun gargaarsa gaafatanii turanillee, loltoonni Israa'el waan hin gargaarreef yeroo ammaa yaaddoo keessa jiru; gareewwan mirga namoomaas waraanni hatattamaan akka isaan gargaaru gaafachaa jiru. Kuni rakkoo fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti dabalaa jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: US inflation eases as food costs cool
english: US inflation slightly decreased to 3.4% in July as food price growth slowed and energy costs dropped. However, overall monthly prices rose slightly, largely driven by rising housing expenses and rent. Federal officials and political leaders continue to monitor the situation, acknowledging that the cost of living remains a significant burden for many households.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የዋጋ ንረት በሐምሌ ወር በትንሹ ወደ 3.4 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል፤ ይህም የሆነው የምግብ ዋጋ መጨመር በመቀነሱ እና የኃይል ማመንጫ ወጪዎች በመውረዳቸው ነው። ሆኖም በወርሃዊ መለኪያ የቤት ኪራይ እና የቤት ዋጋ በመጨመሩ አጠቃላይ የኑሮ ውድነት አሁንም ተግዳሮት ሆኗል። መንግስት እና የፌዴራል ባንክ የዋጋ ንረትን ለመቆጣጠር እና የቤተሰቦችን የኑሮ ጫና ለማቃለል ጥረት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gatiin gabaa Amerikaa baatii Adoolessa keessa gara dhibbeentaa 3.4tti gadi bu'eera; kunis kan ta'e gatiin nyaataa dabaluu hir'achuu fi gatiin anniisaa gadi bu'uu isaatiin. Haa ta'u malee, gatiin mana jireenyaa fi kiree dabaluun isaa baatii keessatti gatiin waliigalaa akka hin hir'anne taasiseera. Hoggantoonni biyyattii fi baankii federaalaa gatii jireenyaa hir'isuufi dinagdee tasgabbeessuuf hojjachaa akka jiran ibsaniiru.

title: Why has North Korea fired a missile ahead of US-South Korea drills?
english: North Korea recently launched a ballistic missile into the sea ahead of upcoming annual military exercises between the United States and South Korea. Pyongyang views these joint defensive drills as preparations for an invasion, leading to increased regional tensions. This event marks the second missile test in less than a week, prompting South Korean officials to call for an immediate end to these provocations.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ ከአሜሪካ እና ከደቡብ ኮሪያ አመታዊ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በፊት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ወደ ባህር ተኩሳለች። ፒዮንግያንግ እነዚህን የመከላከያ ልምምዶች እንደ ወረራ ዝግጅት የምትመለከታቸው በመሆኑ ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። ይህ በሳምንት ውስጥ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የተካሄደ የሚሳኤል ሙከራ ሲሆን፣ የደቡብ ኮሪያ ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ውሳኔዎችን የሚጥስ በመሆኑ በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Koreaan Kaabaa shaakala waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Koriyaa Kibbaa gidduutti gaggeeffamuuf jiru dura sagalee fi meeshaa waraanaa ishee agarsiisuuf boombii balistikiin gara galaanaatti gadi lakkifteetti. Piyoongyaang shaakalli kun waraana nurratti banuuf qophii dha jettee waan amantuuf, kanaanis naannichatti waldhabdee uumteetti. Kun torban tokko keessatti qormaata boombii isa lammaffaa waan ta'eef, mootummaan Koriyaa Kibbaa gochi kun akka dhaabbatu cimsee gaafateera.

title: Egyptian student livestreams his kidnapping
english: An Egyptian student was successfully saved after he broadcast his own abduction live on Facebook while being held in a moving truck. The live video allowed authorities to track his location and intervene. He has since been rescued from his captors.
amharic: ግብጻዊ ተማሪ ታግቶ እያለ በፌስቡክ ቀጥታ ስርጭት በማሳየቱ ህይወቱ ሊተርፍ ችሏል። ተማሪው በመኪና ውስጥ ሆኖ የቀረጸው ቪዲዮ ባለስልጣናት ያሉበትን ቦታ እንዲያውቁና እንዲደርሱለት ረድቷቸዋል። በመጨረሻም ከጠላፊዎቹ እጅ በሰላም ተለቋል።
oromo: Barataan biyya Masrii tokko qabamee osoo butamuun isaa Facebook irratti karaa viidiyoo qajjee (live stream) erguun isaa lubbuun isaa akka oolu isa taasiseera. Barataan kun konkolaataa keessa taa'ee viidiyoo kana erguun isaa, humnoonni nageenyaa iddoo inni jiru beekanii akka isa baasan gargaareera. Bu'aa kanaanis barataan kun buttoota harka keessaa miliquu danda'eera.

title: Top Iranian commander visited Iraq to discuss disarmament plan: Source
english: The head of Iran's Quds Force, Esmail Qaani, recently visited Baghdad for secret talks regarding Iraq's plan to bring all armed groups under state control. Iran reportedly advised against the immediate surrender of weapons, fearing that potential conflict could spark a new regional war. Instead, Tehran is pushing for a political resolution to avoid a violent confrontation between the Iraqi government and various paramilitary factions.
amharic: የኢራኑ የቁድስ ኃይል አዛዥ እስማኤል ጋኒ፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት የታጠቁ ቡድኖችን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት ያለውን እቅድ ለመወያየት በድብቅ ባግዳድ ገብተው ነበር። ኢራን በክልሉ ሌላ ጦርነት ሊቀሰቀስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ የታጠቁ ቡድኖች አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ትጥቃቸውን እንዳይፈቱ ምክር ሰጥታለች። በምትኩም፣ በመንግስት እና በታጠቁ ቡድኖች መካከል ሊፈጠር የሚችለውን ግጭት ለመከላከል በፖለቲካዊ መንገድ መፍትሄ እንዲፈለግ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Ajajaan humna Quds kan Iraan Esmail Qaani, mootummaan Iraaq gareewwan hidhatan harka akka galchan karoorfate irratti mari'achuuf gara Baqdaad imalanii turan. Iraan waraanni naannichatti haaraa akka hin kaane sodaattee, gareewwan hidhatan ammaaf meeshaa isaanii akka hin hiikne gorsa kenniteetti. Kanaa mannaa, mootummaa Iraaqifi gareewwan hidhatan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi akka hin uumamneef, marii siyaasaan furmaata barbaaduun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: Rare solar eclipse to sweep across Europe and the Arctic
english: A rare total solar eclipse is set to occur, passing over the Arctic, Greenland, Iceland, and select regions of Spain. During this event, the Moon will fully block out the Sun, providing a spectacular view for millions of people. This astronomical phenomenon marks a significant and infrequent moment for observers in these northern locations.
amharic: አልፎ አልፎ የሚከሰት ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ በአርክቲክ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በአይስላንድ እና በስፔን አንዳንድ አካባቢዎች እንደሚታይ ተገልጿል። በዚህ ወቅት ጨረቃ ፀሐይን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመሸፈን አስደናቂ ትርኢት የምታሳይ ሲሆን ይህም በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ትኩረት ይስባል። ይህ የሰማይ ክስተት በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች ለሚገኙ ነዋሪዎች ልዩ እና ያልተለመደ አጋጣሚ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaan aduun guutummaatti itti dhokatutti (solar eclipse) naannoo Arktik, Giriinlaand, Aayislaandi fi kutaa biyya Ispeen keessatti mul'achuuf qophaa'eera. Yeroo kanatti jiini aduu guutummaatti waan haguuguuf, namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawaman biratti haala dinqisiisaa ta'een ni mul'ata. Kunuunis taateewwan samii keessatti yeroodhaa gara yerootti mudatan keessaa isa tokko.

title: Erdogan eyes expansion of regional defence pact
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan aims to expand a newly signed defence pact between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan to include other regional nations. While Turkey hopes Egypt will eventually join this collective security agreement, there are reports of internal disagreements among the current members regarding that potential addition. Erdogan emphasized that regional security should be managed by local powers rather than external influences.
amharic: የቱርኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይፕ ኤርዶغان በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመውን አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ወደ ሌሎች የክልሉ ሀገራት ለማስፋት ፍላጎት አላቸው። ቱርክ ግብፅን ወደዚህ የጋራ የደህንነት ስምምነት ለማካተት ብትፈልግም፣ አሁን ባሉት አባላት መካከል በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ ቅራኔዎች መኖራቸው ተሰምቷል። ኤርዶغان የክልሉን ሰላም እና ደህንነት ከውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ይልቅ የክልሉ ሀገራት በራሳቸው ሊመሩት እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan waliigaltee ittisa biyyaa kan Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame gara biyyoota naannoo biroo kanneenitti bal'isuuf yaada qabu. Turkii guddina waliigaltee kanaa keessatti Misir akka hirmaattu kan barbaaddu ta'us, miseensota amma jiran gidduutti yaada wal dhabdee tokko tokko akka jiru gabaafameera. Erdogan nageenyi naannichaa gargaarsa alaa malee, biyyoota naannichaan akka hogganamu qabu hubachiisaniiru.

title: 'This isn't the Britain I grew up in': The activists raided by police over Palestine Action videos
english: Many activists, including elderly individuals, are living in fear of police dawn raids after publicly supporting the banned group Palestine Action in online videos. Authorities have already searched the homes of nearly twenty people, seizing personal electronics and belongings, under strict anti-terrorism laws. These activists are facing potential long-term imprisonment for calling for support of the group, a development that many participants describe as a frightening shift in the political climate.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እርምጃ (Palestine Action) የተባለውን የተከለከለ ቡድን በኢንተርኔት ቪዲዮዎች በመደገፋቸው ምክንያት በርካታ አክቲቪስቶች የፖሊስ ድንገተኛ እስር በመፍራት ላይ ይገኛሉ። በአሸባሪነት ህግ መሰረት ባለስልጣናት ቀድሞውንም የሃያ ያህል ሰዎችን ቤት በመበርበር የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሳሪያዎችንና ሌሎች ንብረቶችን ወርሰዋል። ለቡድኑ ድጋፍ በመጠየቃቸው ምክንያት ከባድ የእስር ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Namoonni hedduun, kanneen keessatti maanguddoonni argaman, garee Palestine Action jedhamu kan seeraan dhorkame viidiyoo irratti waan deggaraniif humnootni poolisii mana isaanii irra dhufee akka isaan qabu yaaddoo keessa jiru. Seera shororkeessummaa fayyadamnee, qaamoleen mootummaa namoota digdamii gadi ta'an mana isaanii seenee meeshaalee elektirooniksii fi qabeenya dhuunfaa isaanii fudhatanii jiru. Namoonni kun garee kana deggaruuf waamicha waan godhaniif hidhaa waggoota hedduu itti murteeffamuu danda'a, kunis haala siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: The war on Iran cracked the US-led regional order. The Mecca pact could deal the final blow
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed a new joint defense pact known as the Mecca Agreement, establishing a mutual defense commitment similar to NATO. This alliance forms a strategic arc around Iran, combining Saudi financial resources, Turkish military manufacturing, and Pakistan's nuclear capabilities. Experts suggest this move signals a shift away from reliance on American security guarantees, marking a potential end to the U.S.-led order that has governed Middle Eastern regional stability for decades.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት፣ እንደ ኔቶ ያለ የጋራ መከላከያ ግዴታን ይፈጥራል። ይህ ጥምረት የሳዑዲን ሀብት፣ የቱርክን ወታደራዊ ኢንዱስትሪ እና የፓኪስታንን የኒውክሌር አቅም በማቀናጀት ኢራንን የሚከብ ስትራቴጂያዊ መዋቅር ይፈጥራል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ቀደም ሲል በአሜሪካ ይመራ የነበረው የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የጸጥታ መዋቅር እየተዳከመ መሆኑን እና አገራቱ በራሳቸው ጥምረት ለመተማመን መምረጣቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa waliinii kan Makkaatti mallatteessan, akka biyyoota NATO wal-gargaaruuf kan waadaa galan dha. Walitti-bahiin kun qabeenya Saudii, industirii waraanaa Turkii fi humna niwukilaraa Paakistaan walitti fidun Iran naannoo ishee kan marsee jiru dha. Tarkaanfiin kun sirni nageenyaa hoggansa Ameerikaatiin durfamaa turee fi waggoota dheeraaf naannichatti ture sun akka laaffachaa jiru fi biyyoonni kunneen fedhii nageenyaa isaanii ofiin danda'uuf akka murteessan kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Putin warns of tit-for-tat seizures of European vessels
english: President Vladimir Putin has threatened to retaliate if European nations proceed with plans to confiscate Russian commercial ships and their cargo. This warning follows recent European Union sanctions that authorize the seizure and potential sale of Russian vessels suspected of violating oil trade regulations. Putin described these actions as acts of theft and confirmed that he has ordered the Russian military to prepare for reciprocal measures against European ships globally.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሩሲያ የንግድ መርከቦችን እና ጭነታቸውን የሚነጥቁ ከሆነ ተመሳሳይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠነቀቁ። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰማው የአውሮፓ ህብረት ማዕቀቦችን በመተላለፍ የሩሲያ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ይዘው የተገኙ መርከቦችን ለመያዝ እና ለመሸጥ በወሰነው ውሳኔ ነው። ፑቲን ይህን ድርጊት ዘረፋ ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ የሩሲያ የጦር ኃይሎች በአውሮፓ መርከቦች ላይ ተመሳሳይ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ማዘዛቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vladiimiir Puutin biyyoonni Awurooppaa markaboota daldalaa Raashiyaa fi fe'umsa isaanii kan fudhatan yoo ta'e, akkaataa wal fakkaatuun akka deebisanii gafaatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe, gamtaan Awurooppaa seeraan ala boba'aa fe'anii argaman jedhamanii kan shakaman markaboota Raashiyaa qabachuu fi gurguruuf murteessuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Puutin gocha kana saamicha jechuun kan ibsan yoo ta'u, raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Raashiyaa markaboota Awurooppaa irratti tarkaanfii wal fakkaataa akka fudhatan ajaja kennuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Lebanon ends executions: Where does the death penalty still exist in 2026?
english: Lebanon has officially abolished the death penalty, becoming the first nation in the Middle East to do so, by replacing capital punishment with life imprisonment and hard labor. Although the country had not carried out any executions since 2004, the law formalizes this shift for the 85 prisoners currently on death row. Globally, approximately three-quarters of countries have now ended the death penalty, despite recent increases in executions in certain regions like Iran.
amharic: ሊባኖስ በቅርቡ የሞት ቅጣትን በይፋ በመሻር ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደች የመጀመሪያዋ የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሀገር ሆናለች፤ ይህም ቅጣት አሁን በእድሜ ልክ እስራት እና በግዴታ የጉልበት ስራ ተተክቷል። ሀገሪቱ ከ2004 ጀምሮ የሞት ፍርድ ተግባራዊ ባታደርግም፣ ይህ አዲስ ህግ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሞት ቅጣት እስር ላይ ለሚገኙ 85 ግለሰቦች እጣ ፈንታ ወሳኝ ሆኗል። በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከሶስት አራተኛ በላይ የሚሆኑ ሀገራት የሞት ቅጣትን ያስወገዱ ቢሆንም፣ በኢራን እና በሌሎች ጥቂት ሀገራት የቅጣቱ አፈጻጸም መጨመሩ አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Libanoon adabbii du'aa seera keessaa haquudhaan biyya jalqabaa mootummoota giddu galeessa bahaa taateetti; adabbiin du'aa kunis amma hidhaa cimaa fi hojii dirqamaatiin bakka bu'eera. Biyyi kun bara 2004 irraa eegalee nam tokkollee osoo hin ajjeesin ture; seera haaraan kun garuu namoota 85 duraan adabbii du'aatti murtaa'anii turaniif furmaata ta'eera. Sadarkaa addunyaatti biyyoonni hedduun adabbii kana dhiisanii kan jiran ta'us, biyyoota akka Iraanitti lakkoofsi namoota ajjeefamanii dabaluun isaa yaaddeessaadha.

title: Woman rescued after 36 hours under rubble in Colombia
english: A woman has been successfully pulled from the debris in Colombia after being trapped for a day and a half. Emergency crews worked extensively to reach her following a structural collapse. She is currently receiving medical attention after her miraculous survival.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በአንድ ህንፃ ፍርስራሽ ስር ለ36 ሰዓታት ተይዛ የቆየች ሴት በህይወት ተረፈች። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ከባድ ጥረት አድርገው ሴትየዋን ከፍርስራሹ ማውጣት ችለዋል። በአሁኑ ሰዓት ሴትየዋ አስፈላጊውን የህክምና እርዳታ እያገኘች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti dubartiin tokko erga sa’aatii 36 guutuu caccabaa manaa jala turtee booda lubbuun ishee oolcheera. Gargaartonni hatattamaa carraaqqii cimaa godhaniin dubartittii caccabaa keessaa baasuu danda’aniiru. Amma yaaliin fayyaa godhamaafii jira.

title: Iran refutes Trump’s claim to ‘control’ Hormuz: What’s the latest in talks?
english: Iran has rejected Donald Trump's assertion that the U.S. fully controls the Strait of Hormuz, maintaining that the waterway will stay closed until Washington addresses Iran's demands. Since the conflict began in February, the strait has remained a major global flashpoint, causing significant disruptions to international shipping and energy supplies. While the U.S. claims dominance, military activity and attacks on vessels continue to intensify, leaving diplomatic efforts to resolve the crisis at a standstill.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያን ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደሚቆጣጠሩት የዶናልድ ትራምፕን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። አገሪቱ አሜሪካ እስክትቀበላቸው ድረስ የመተላለፊያ መንገዱ ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቃለች። ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ ይህ የባህር መንገድ ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እና የመርከብ ጉዞ ትልቅ ስጋት በመሆኑ ውጥረቱን አባብሶታል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአካባቢው ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ እና የጥቃት ስጋቶች ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎችን አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Iraan ibsa Doonald Traamp kan isaan harka qulqulluun daandii galaana Hormuz to'achuu isaanii dubbatan fudhatama dhabsiisteerti. Iraan hanga Ameerikaan gaaffii ishee fudhatutti daandichi cufaa akka ta'u beeksisteerti. Giddugalli kun erga waraanni jalqabee asii addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa uumeera, akkasumas sochii dooniiwwan idil-addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa ta'eera. Gama biraatiin, waraanni fi haleellaan naannichatti itti fufee waan jiruuf, mariin nagaa sadarkaa duraa irratti dhaabbatee jira.

title: Libya reels from assassination, oil strikes and central bank turmoil
english: Libya is facing a significant security and economic crisis following a string of violent events, including a deadly car bombing that killed a top eastern military official and drone strikes on the country's largest oil refinery. Tensions are further complicated by the resignation of the central bank governor, highlighting the fragile state of the nation's political institutions. Analysts suggest these attacks reflect ongoing power struggles between rival factions that threaten the country's stability and energy production.
amharic: ሊቢያ ከፍተኛ የፀጥታ እና የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብታለች። በቤንጋዚ የተፈጸመው የመኪና ቦምብ ፍንዳታ ከፍተኛ የጦር መኮንን የገደለ ሲሆን፣ በአገሪቱ ትልቁ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ የተፈጸመው የድሮን ጥቃትም የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል። የሀገሪቱ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ ገዥ መልቀቅ እና እየተባባሰ የመጣው የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት በሊቢያ ውስጥ ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ ምን ያህል ደካማ እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Libiyaan rakkoo nageenyaa fi diinagdee cimaa keessa jirti. Ajjeechaan boombii konkolaataa irratti raawwatamee fi haleellaan xiyyara malee (drone) rafinerii boba'aa biyyattii guddicha irratti gaggeeffame tasgabbii dhabuu biyyattii agarsiisa. Walitti dhufeenyaan giddugala baankii biyyattii fi rakkoon siyaasaa biyyattii keessa jiru, haalli nageenyaa fi dhaabbileen biyyattii hangam akka laafan kan ibsu dha.

title: Turkey's cross party Kurdish peace coalition makes history with PKK clemency law
english: The Turkish parliament has passed a historic law offering partial amnesty to members of the PKK who have not committed violent crimes, aiming to end decades of conflict. This legislative breakthrough follows months of negotiations involving government leaders, opposition parties, and imprisoned PKK leader Abdullah Ocalan. The initiative is particularly notable for gaining support from a wide political spectrum, including nationalist and secular parties that were previously long-time opponents of such peace efforts.
amharic: የቱርክ ፓርላማ የአስርት ዓመታትን ያስቆጠረው ግጭት እንዲያበቃ በማሰብ፣ ከባድ የኃይል ወንጀል ያልፈጸሙ የፒኬኬ (PKK) አባላትን በከፊል ይቅርታ የሚሰጥ ታሪካዊ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ ህግ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች እና በእስር ላይ የሚገኙት የቡድኑ መሪ አብዱላህ ኦጃላን ካደረጓቸው ወራት የዘለቁ ድርድሮች በኋላ የመጣ ነው። ለዚህ ሰላማዊ ጥረት የቱርክ ብሔርተኞች እና ዓለማዊ ፓርቲዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ የፖለቲካ ድጋፍ ማግኘቱ ጉዳዩን ልዩ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Parlamaan Turkiyaa waldhabdee waggoota hedduu ture xumuruuf, miseensota PKK kan yakka hiddii fi ajjeechaa hin raawwatinif dhiifama gartokkee kennu seera seenseera. Murtii seena qabeessa kana kan irra gahame marii ji'ootaaf mootummaa, paartilee mormituu fi hogganaa hidhaa keessa jiran Abdullah Ocalan gidduutti godhameen booda. Kana dura diina walii kan turan paartileen siyaasaa garaa garaa, keessattuu paartileen biyyaalessaa fi kanneen amantii, waltajjiin kun deggarsa bal'aa argachuu isaatiin adda taasiseera.

title: Iran and US did not discuss ceasefire extension, senior Iranian official says
english: A high-ranking Iranian official stated that there were no talks with the United States regarding a ceasefire extension. Tehran argues that because the original agreement lacked a specific start date, there was no official deal to prolong. Therefore, Iran maintains that no discussions on this matter took place.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን እንደተናገሩት፣ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን ስለማራዘም ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም አይነት ውይይት አልተደረገም። ኢራን እንደምትለው፣ የመጀመሪያው ስምምነት የተጀመረበት ቀን ስለሌለው የሚራዘም ነገር የለም። በዚህም ምክንያት በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ ምንም አይነት ድርድር አለመካሄዱን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Iraan akka jedhanitti, walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa dheeressuu ilaalchisee Ameerikaa waliin mariin kamiyyuu hin taasifamne. Iraan akka ibsitetti, walii galteen jalqabaa guyyaa itti eegale waan hin qabneef, wanti dheeratu hin jiru. Kanaafuu, dhimma kana irratti mariin tokkollee akka hin gaggeeffamne ibsitee jirti.

title: Reform UK's love affair with a Middle Eastern dictatorship
english: Nigel Farage, leader of Reform UK, has shifted his stance significantly from past criticisms of the United Arab Emirates to now openly courting the Gulf nation. During a recent event in Dubai, Farage praised the UAE's governance and expressed a desire to model his constituency after their development. This change in tone marks a strategic shift for the party as they position themselves as a potential future government with close ties to the Emirati leadership.
amharic: የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲ መሪ ናይጄል ፋራጅ ከዚህ ቀደም የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትን በአምባገነንነትና በሰብአዊ መብት ረገጣ ይተቹ የነበረ ቢሆንም አሁን ግን ግንኙነታቸውን ማጠናከራቸው ታይቷል። በቅርቡ በዱባይ በተካሄደ ዝግጅት ላይ ፋራጅ የኤምሬትን የአስተዳደር ስልት በማድነቅ ለወደፊት የፓርቲያቸው የውጭ ግንኙነት ቁልፍ አጋር እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አካሄድ የፓርቲው መሪ በነበራቸው አቋም ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ መደረጉን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ለወደፊት ስልጣን ሲታጩም አገሪቱን ከአቡ ዳቢ ጋር ለማቀራረብ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Reform UK, Nigel Farage, kanaan dura biyya Emireetota Arabaa tokkumman (UAE) irratti qeeqaa cimaa qabanis, amma garuu hariiroo cimaa uummachaa jiru. Ayyaana Dubai keessatti qophaa'e irratti, Farage sirna bulchiinsa UAE kan faarsan yoo ta'u, biyyi isaanii gara fuulduraatti hariiroo cimaa biyyattii wajjin qabaachu akka barbaadan dubbataniiru. Jijjiiramni kun ilaalcha isaanii kanaan duraa wajjin wal faallessuun, paartichi gara fuulduraatti mootummaa ta'uuf carraa qabaachuun, xiyyeeffannoon isaanii gara biyyoota Gulfiitti akka garagale agarsiisa.

title: Four killed in the Red Sea as Houthis claim ship attack
english: Four crew members were killed after Houthi forces attacked an Egyptian-owned cargo ship in the Red Sea. The victims included three Pakistani nationals and one Indonesian citizen. While the Houthis claimed the vessel was transporting Saudi military equipment, this incident marks the first fatalities from their ongoing maritime campaign.
amharic: የሑቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ በግብፅ ባለቤትነት የተያዘ የጭነት መርከብ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት አራት የመርከቧ ሠራተኞች ተገድለዋል። ከተገደሉት መካከል ሦስት ፓኪስታናውያን እና አንድ ኢንዶኔዥያዊ ይገኙበታል። ሑቲዎች መርከቧ የሳዑዲ ወታደራዊ መሳሪያዎችን ጭና ነበር በማለት ጥቃቱን ያደረሱ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ክስተት በቡድኑ ጥቃት የሰው ሕይወት ሲያልፍ የመጀመሪያው ነው።
oromo: Humni Huthitti markaba fe'umsaa kan gibxotaa ta'e tokko galaana diimaa irratti erga haleelee booda, namoota afur ajjeeseera. Namoota du'an keessaa saddeeti lammiilee Paakistaan yoo ta'an, tokko immoo lammii Indoneeziyaa ti. Huthittiin markabittiin kun meeshaalee waraanaa Sa'udii fe'attee akka jirtu himatanis, haleellaan kun du'a qaqqabsiise isa jalqabaa dha.

title: Wisconsin result halts winning streak for Democratic Party's left wing
english: David Crowley, a centrist Democrat and Milwaukee County executive, has narrowly defeated Francesca Hong in the Wisconsin gubernatorial primary. This victory marks a significant setback for the party's progressive wing, which had previously been experiencing a series of electoral successes. Crowley is now set to compete against Republican candidate Tom Tiffany in the upcoming November election.
amharic: የሚልዋውኪ ካውንቲ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ የሆኑት መካከለኛ አቋም ያላቸው ዴሞክራት ዴቪድ ክራውሊ በዊስኮንሲን የገዢነት ምርጫ ፕራይመሪ ፍራንቼስካ ሆንግን በትንሽ ልዩነት አሸንፈዋል። ይህ ውጤት በቅርቡ በተለያዩ ምርጫዎች ስኬታማ ሲሆኑ የቆዩትን የፓርቲው ግራ ዘመም አባላት ጉዞ ያደናቀፈ ሆኗል። ክራውሊ በኖቬምበር በሚደረገው ዋና ምርጫ ከሪፐብሊካኑ እጩ ቶም ቲፋኒ ጋር ይወዳደራሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni damee milwaakii kan ta'an fi yaadota giddugaleessa kan qaban, Deevid Kiraawulii, filannoo duraa kan mootummaa wiiskonsiin keessatti, Fireancheeskaa Hongiin sagalee xiqqoon mo'ataniiru. Injifannoon kun gartuu jijjiirama barbaadu (left-wing) kan garee dimokiraatotaa kan yeroo dhihoo as milkaa'ina argataa turan dhaabsiseera. Kiraawuliin filannoo biyyoolessaa Sadaasa dhufu gaggeeffamu irratti kan morkatu kaadhimamaa riippuubliikanii kan ta'an Toom Tifaanii waliin ta'a.

title: ‘The hardest mission of my life’: A rescuer’s loss in the Lebanon War
english: During the 2006 Lebanon War, a rescue worker named Ali Safiuddin moved his wife and young daughter to his station for protection, mistakenly believing they would be safer with him. Tragically, an Israeli airstrike hit the facility, resulting in the deaths of his family members. This devastating personal loss continues to deeply influence his perspective and dedication as a first responder today.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2006 በሊባኖስ ጦርነት ወቅት አሊ ሳፊዩዲን የተባሉ አዳኝ፣ ባለቤታቸውን እና ትንሽ ልጃቸውን ይበልጥ ደህና ይሆናሉ ብለው በማሰብ ወደ ሥራ ቦታቸው ወስደዋቸው ነበር። ነገር ግን በእስራኤል የቦምብ ጥቃት ጣቢያው ሲመታ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የግል ኪሳራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በሥራቸው ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Waraana Libaanoos bara 2006 keessa, namni lubbuu baraaruu Ali Safiuddin jedhamu, haadha manaa fi intala isaa xiqquu gara buufata hojii isaatti geessee ture. Garuu, haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el iddoo sana erga rukutee booda, maatiin isaa du'aniiru. Miidhaan kun hanga har'aatti hojii isaa fi jireenya isaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba.

title: More than 100 passengers rescued after Indonesia ferry fire
english: A passenger ferry traveling between Bali and Lombok in Indonesia recently caught fire, triggering an emergency rescue operation. Authorities successfully evacuated over 100 people who were on board the vessel. Unfortunately, officials confirmed that one individual lost their life during the incident.
amharic: ኢንዶኔዢያ ውስጥ ከባሊ ወደ ሎምቦክ ሲጓዝ የነበረ የጭነት እና የተሳፋሪ መርከብ በእሳት በመያዙ ምክንያት የአደጋ ጊዜ የነፍስ አድን ስራ ተካሄዷል። ከመርከቧ ውስጥ ከ100 በላይ ተሳፋሪዎች እና ሰራተኞች በህይወት መትረፍ ችለዋል። ሆኖም በዚህ አሳዛኝ አደጋ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Indooneziyaatti markaba imaltoota baatee Baliifi Lombok gidduutti imalaa turte tokko irratti ibidda ka'een hojiin oolchiinsaa hatattamaa ta'e godhameera. Bulchiinsichi namoota markabichaa keessa turan 100 ol ta'an lubbuun oolchuuf danda'eera. Ta'us, rakkoo kana keessatti namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbuun ibsameera.

title: Pogba suffers new injury setback with Monaco future now in doubt
english: French midfielder Paul Pogba has faced a new setback after injuring his thigh during a training camp with Monaco in England. This latest physical issue follows his recent struggle with knee problems and has led to rumors that the club may terminate his contract early. The 33-year-old, who previously served an 18-month doping ban, has seen his playing time significantly limited since joining the team.
amharic: የፈረንሳዩ አማካይ ፖል ፖግባ በእንግሊዝ የሞናኮ ልምምድ ወቅት በጭኑ ላይ በደረሰበት ጉዳት አዲስ ፈተና ገጥሞታል። ይህ አዲስ የጤና ችግር ቀደም ሲል ከነበረበት የጉልበት ጉዳት በተጨማሪ የመጣ በመሆኑ፣ ክለቡ የውል ስምምነቱን ሊያቋርጥ እንደሚችል እየተነገረ ነው። የቀድሞው የዓለም ዋንጫ አሸናፊ የሆነው የ33 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረበት የዶፒንግ ክልከላ እና ተደጋጋሚ ጉዳቶች ለሜዳ መመለሱን አስቸጋሪ አድርገውበታል።
oromo: Taphataan sarara gidduu Faransaay Pool Pogbaan, yeroo leenjii garee isaa Monakoo kan Ingiliizitti godhaterratti miidhama mudannoo biraa isa mudateera. Miidhaan kun kan isaa mudate erga miidhaa jilbaatiin rakkattee booda waan ta'eef, kilabichi waliigaltee isaa addaan kutuu mala jedhamee shakkamaa jira. Taphataan umurii waggaa 33 kun, kanaan dura dhimma dhukkubee of fayyisuu (doping) waliin walqabatee waggaa tokkoofi ji'a ja'aaf tapha irraa fagaatee kan ture yommuu ta'u, erga gara Monakoo dhufee asis yeroo baay'ee miidhamaan tapha irraa fagaachaa jira.

title: Zambia’s president rallies for second term ahead of election
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema recently held a massive campaign rally in Lusaka as he seeks re-election for a second term. The upcoming vote is heavily influenced by public concerns regarding the country's rising cost of living and current unemployment rates. Thousands of supporters attended the event to show their backing for the president's platform.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃካኢንዴ ሂቺሌማ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የስልጣን ዘመን በዋና ከተማዋ ሉሳካ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ያሳተፈ ትልቅ የምረቃ ሰልፍ አካሂደዋል። መጪው ምርጫ በዋናነት የተመሰረተው በሀገሪቱ የኑሮ ውድነት እና በስራ አጥነት ችግሮች ዙሪያ ነው። ለምርጫው በዝግጅት ላይ ያለው መንግስት የህዝቡን የኢኮኖሚ ስጋቶች ለመፍታት ቃል እየገባ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin biyya Zaambiyaa Hakainde Hichilema yeroo lammaffaaf filatamuuf magaalaa guddittii Lusakaatti walgahii uummataa guddaa ta'e taasisaniiru. Filannoon dhufu kun baasii jireenyaa olka'aa fi rakkoo hojidhabdummaa biyyattii keessa jiru irratti xiyyeeffata. Kumaatama kan lakkaa'aman deggertoonni pirezedaantichaas sagalee isaanii kennuuf qophii ta'uu ibsataniiru.

title: Singapore and S Korea pull Trader Joe's seasoning over poppy seeds
english: Singapore and South Korea have banned the sale of Trader Joe's 'Everything But the Bagel' seasoning due to the inclusion of poppy seeds, which are strictly prohibited. Authorities removed the product from online platforms after tests in South Korea detected traces of morphine and codeine, substances derived from the poppy plant. Officials in both nations have warned the public against consuming the seasoning, emphasizing their zero-tolerance policies regarding controlled drugs.
amharic: ሲንጋፖር እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ በውስጡ የፓፒ ዘር (poppy seeds) በመያዙ ምክንያት የታወቀውን የትሬደር ጆ 'ኤቭሪቲንግ ባት ዘ ቤግል' ቅመም መሸጥ ከልክለዋል። በደቡብ ኮሪያ በተደረገ ምርመራ በቅመሙ ውስጥ ሞርፊን እና ኮዴን የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ንጥረ ነገሮች ከፓፒ ተክል የሚገኙ አደንዛዥ ዕፆች በመሆናቸው በሁለቱም አገራት የተከለከሉ ናቸው። ባለስልጣናት ህዝቡ ይህንን ቅመም እንዳይጠቀምና እንዲያስወግድ አሳስበዋል፤ አገራቱ በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ላይ ያላቸውን ጥብቅ የተቃውሞ አቋምም አጽንኦት ሰጥተውበታል።
oromo: Siingappoorii fi Koriyaan Kibbaa zayita 'Everything But the Bagel' kan Trader Joe’s jedhamu, sanyii paapii (poppy seeds) waan qabuuf gabaa irraa kaasuuf murteessaniiru. Koriyaan Kibbaa keessatti qorannoon godhameen, sanyiin kun qoricha sammuu hadoochu kan akka moorfinii fi koodiinii of keessaa qabaachuu isaa erga mirkaneessee booda, meeshichi marsariitiiwwan gurgurtaa irraa kaafameera. Mootummoonni biyyoota lamaanii, seeraan dhorkaa ta’e kana fayyadamuu irraa akka of qusatan ummata akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: A hydrogen-powered vehicle sets new land speed record
english: A British engineering firm named JCB has officially broken the world land speed record for a hydrogen-fueled vehicle. This achievement highlights the company's commitment to developing hydrogen combustion engines as a clean, carbon-free energy source. The project aims to demonstrate that hydrogen is a viable alternative for powering heavy industrial equipment.
amharic: ጄሲቢ (JCB) የተባለ የብሪታኒያ የምህንድስና ኩባንያ በሃይድሮጅን የሚሰራ ተሽከርካሪ ለአለም የምድር ላይ የፍጥነት ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ስኬት ኩባንያው ሃይድሮጅንን እንደ ንጹህ እና ካርቦን አልባ የነዳጅ አማራጭ ለማስተዋወቅ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት ያሳያል። ፕሮጀክቱ ሃይድሮጅን ለከባድ ማሽነሪዎች አስተማማኝ የኃይል ምንጭ መሆን እንደሚችል ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni injinaringii biyya Ingiliz JCB jedhamu, konkolaataa haayidroojiinii fayyadamuun rekardii saffisa lafa irraa haaraa galmeesseera. Milkaa'inni kun, haayidroojiinii akka filannoo anniisaa qulqulluu fi kaarboonii hin qabneetti fayyadamuuf hojii dhaabbatichi hojjetaa jiru kan ibsuudha. Pirojektichi kun haayidroojiiniin maashinoota gurguddaadhaaf anniisaa mijaataa ta'uu isaa agarsiisuuf kan karoorfamedha.

title: Rybakina defeats Osaka, advances to Canadian Open semifinals to play Gauff
english: Elena Rybakina successfully rallied from a set and a break down to defeat Naomi Osaka in a challenging quarterfinal match at the Canadian Open. Following this hard-fought victory, Rybakina is set to face Coco Gauff in the semifinals. Gauff advanced automatically after her opponent, Belinda Bencic, withdrew from the tournament due to injury.
amharic: ኤሌና ሪባኪና በካናዳ ኦፕን የሩብ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ በናኦሚ ኦሳካ ተሸንፋ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አስደናቂ ተጋድሎ በማድረግ ተመልሳ ማሸነፍ ችላለች። በዚህ ድል ምክንያት ሪባኪና በግማሽ ፍጻሜው ከኮኮ ጋውፍ ጋር ትገጥማለች። ጋውፍ ወደ ግማሽ ፍጻሜው ያለፈችው ተቀናቃኟ ቤሊንዳ ቤንቺች በጉዳት ምክንያት ከውድድሩ በመውጣቷ ነው።
oromo: Elena Rybakina tapha rammaa Canadian Open irratti Naomi Osaka irratti injifannoo ajaa'ibaa argattee gara walakkaa xumuraatti darbeetti. Injifannoo kanaan booda, Rybakina walakkaa xumuraarratti Coco Gauff wajjin kan taphattu ta'a. Gauff gara walakkaa xumuraatti kan darbite morkattuun ishee Belinda Bencic miidhaa qaamaatiin taphicha keessaa waan baateef dha.

title: Wisconsin race tight: Key takeaways from US primary election results
english: The Democratic gubernatorial primary in Wisconsin remains too close to call between progressive Francesca Hong and moderate David Crowley. This contest highlights a significant ideological divide within the party as voters decide between traditional establishment figures and more left-leaning candidates. Similar primary elections were held across several other states, revealing mixed results for candidates supported by Donald Trump.
amharic: በዊስኮንሲን የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የገዢነት ምርጫ፣ ተራማጇ ፍራንቼስካ ሆንግ እና መካከለኛው ዴቪድ ክራውሊ በጣም ተቀራራቢ ውጤት አስመዝግበዋል። ይህ ውድድር በፓርቲው ውስጥ በመካከለኛ እና በግራ ዘመም አመለካከት ያላቸው እጩዎች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት የሚያሳይ ነው። ሌሎች በርካታ ግዛቶችም ተመሳሳይ ምርጫዎችን ያካሄዱ ሲሆን፣ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍ የተደረገላቸው እጩዎች በተለያዩ ውጤቶች ተጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimokiraata kan wixxata darbe Wiiskonsiinitti gaggeeffame keessatti, dorgomtoonni Fransiskaa Hong fi Deevid Krawolii wal-caaluu dadhabanii jiru. Dorgommiin kun yaada adda addaa kan paartichaa keessatti jiru kan ibsu yoo ta'u, filattoonni giddu-galeessummaa fi gara bitaatti kan hidhatan gidduutti filachaa jiru. Filannoon kun biyyoota biroo keessattis kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, kaadhimamtoonni Donald Traampin deeggaramanis bu'aa adda addaa galmeessaniiru.

title: Wildberries under fire: Why is Ukraine targeting a Russian retail giant?
english: Ukraine is increasingly targeting Wildberries, Russia’s largest online retailer, by launching drone strikes against its warehouses deep inside Russian territory. Kyiv views these facilities as vital components of the Russian economy and aims to bring the reality of the war directly to the Russian public. These attacks have caused significant infrastructure damage and employee casualties, disrupting the shopping habits of many citizens who rely on the platform.
amharic: ዩክሬን የሩሲያ ትልቁ የኢ-ኮሜርስ ኩባንያ የሆነውን ዋይልድቤሪስን (Wildberries) ኢላማ በማድረግ በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ መጋዘኖቹ ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት እየፈጸመች ነው። ኪይቭ እነዚህን መጋዘኖች የሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ ዋና አካል አድርጋ በመቁጠር የጦርነቱን ተፅዕኖ በቀጥታ ለሩሲያ ህዝብ ለማድረስ ትሞክራለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በመሰረተ ልማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረስ እና የኩባንያውን አገልግሎት በማስተጓጎል በድረ-ገጹ ላይ ጥገኛ በሆኑ ሸማቾች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Yukireen guddina dinagdee Ruusiyaa miidhuuf jetee, dhaabbata gurgurtaa intarneetii kan Ruusiyaa 'Wildberries' jedhamu irratti gammoojjii Ruusiyaa keessatti weerara xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeessaa jirti. Kiev dhaabbata kana qaxanaa dinagdee Ruusiyaa keessatti bakka barbaachisaa jedhee waan ilaaluf, waraanichi akka biyya isaanitti dhagahamuuf jecha kanneen kaayyoo godhattee jirti. Weerarri kun miidhaa qabeenyaa fi qe'ee dhaabbatichaa irra gahuu duwwaa osoo hin taane, namoota meeshaa bitachuuf dhaabbata kanatti hirkatan irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira.

title: Clacton by-election: Farage may win the town, but can he win the country?
english: Nigel Farage is widely expected to win his seat in the Clacton-on-Sea by-election, maintaining his local popularity. However, his party, Reform UK, is currently facing declining national poll numbers and financial controversy. Experts remain uncertain about the party's future success, as the UK's political landscape becomes increasingly fragmented.

Haalli siyaasaa biyyattii waan jijjiiramaa jiruufi walxaxaa waan ta'eef, gara fuulduraatti milkaa'ina paartichaa ilaalchisee hayyoonni waan mirkanaa'e dubbachuu hin dandeenye.

title: Pakistan interior minister in Iran for talks
english: Pakistan's interior minister, Mohsin Naqvi, is currently in Iran to meet with top government officials, including the president. The discussions are focused on strengthening bilateral ties and improving security and stability across the region. During his visit, Naqvi delivered a special message from Pakistan's prime minister and military leadership to the Iranian president.

oromo: Ministirri dhimma keessaa Paakistaan Mohsin Naqvi, marii mootummaa fi nageenyaa irratti irratti mari'achuuf gara biyya Iraan imaleera. Hojiin isaa inni guddaan hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru cimsuu fi nageenya naannichaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu dha. Imala kana irratti ministirichi ergaa addaa muummee ministiraa fi hogganoota waraana Paakistaan irraa ergame pirezidaantii Iraaniif dabarseera.

title: Burnham is the new captain, but he's charting the same course on Israel
english: Andy Burnham has replaced Keir Starmer as British Prime Minister, aiming to revitalize the Labour Party with a focus on domestic economic reform and public services. While he enjoys strong initial popularity and has introduced popular social policies, critics argue his stance on foreign policy remains largely unchanged. Specifically, despite his apologies regarding the party's past response to the conflict in Gaza, his administration continues to support Israel's military actions, drawing skepticism about his commitment to real change.
amharic: አንዲ በርንሃም የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በመሆን ኬይር ስታርመርን ተክተዋል፤ አዲሱ መሪ የሌበር ፓርቲን በኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ እና በህዝብ አገልግሎት ላይ በማተኮር ለማነቃቃት እየሰሩ ነው። በርንሃም በሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳዮች ላይ ተቀባይነት ቢያገኙም፣ በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ ግን የቀድሞውን አካሄድ እንደቀጠሉ ተቺዎች ይናገራሉ። በተለይም በጋዛ ጉዳይ ላይ ይቅርታ ቢጠይቁም፣ መንግስታቸው ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ መስጠቱን በመቀጠሉ ምክንያት የገባውን የለውጥ ቃል አጠያያቂ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Andy Burnham jijjiiruu Keir Starmer ta'uun muummicha ministeeraa biyya Britaan ta'anii jiru; kunis paartii Labour jijjiirama dinagdee fi tajaajila hawaasummaa irratti xiyyeeffatuun haaromsuuf kan kaayyeeffatedha. Burnham gama siyaasa keessoo biyyaatiin fudhatama argatanis, ilaalchi isaanii gama siyaasa alaa irratti garuu kan duraanii wajjin wal fakkaatu akka ta'e mormitoonni ni dubbatu. Keessattuu, dhimma Gaza irratti dhiifama gaafatanis, mootummaan isaanii gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'eliif kennuu waan itti fufaniif, waadaa jijjiiramaa galan irratti shakkii uumee jira.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions are escalating across the Middle East as US President Donald Trump expressed distrust toward Iran, asserting control over the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, deadly Houthi attacks on commercial vessels and civilian casualties from US strikes in Yemen have been reported. Furthermore, military activities continue to disrupt the region, including Iranian drone strikes in Iraq and ongoing Israeli operations in Lebanon and Syria.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት እየተባባሰ ይገኛል፤ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአይራን እንደማያምኑ በመግለጽ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደሚቆጣጠሩ ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲዎች የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ለሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ምክንያት ሆኗል፣ የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች በየመን በርካታ ሲቪሎችን እንደገደሉም ተገልጿል። በተያያዘም ኢራን በኢራቅ ላይ ያደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት እና እስራኤል በሊባኖስና ሶሪያ እያካሄደችው ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት አባብሶታል።

title: Attack on ship in Red Sea kills three Pakistani nationals, wounds another
english: Three Pakistani citizens were killed and one was injured following a Houthi attack on a commercial ship in the Red Sea. The Pakistani Foreign Minister condemned the assault, noting that it violates international law and threatens global maritime safety. Pakistan is currently monitoring the situation and coordinating with the relevant authorities to address the incident.

Paakistaan haala uumame hordofaa jirtuufi qaamolee dhimmi ilaallatu wajjin walitti dhufeenya uumuun hojjachaa jirti.

title: Three killed in overnight attacks on Russian, Ukrainian port cities
english: Deadly overnight drone strikes occurred in both Russia and Ukraine, resulting in three total deaths. A Ukrainian attack on the Russian port city of Novorossiysk killed a child and damaged several buildings, while Russian drone strikes in Ukraine’s Kherson region killed two people. These exchanges reflect an ongoing intensification of attacks on key infrastructure, including grain terminals, fuel depots, and power facilities in both countries.

Weeraronni kunniin lamaanuu buufataalee gabaa, bakka boba'aan kuufamuufi dhaabbilee humna elektirikii irratti xiyyeeffachuun wal waraansuun isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump says his decoy plane faced ‘greater risk’ in secret flight change
english: President Donald Trump revealed that he secretly switched planes during a July NATO summit in Turkey following warnings of a potential assassination threat from Iran. To ensure his safety, officials moved him to a different aircraft using a catering truck while his original plane continued to fly with staff on board. Trump noted that he believes the decoy plane he eventually traveled on was actually at higher risk of being targeted.

title: Israeli government accused of complicity as settlers demolish Jericho homes
english: Israeli settlers have been using excavators to demolish Palestinian homes and property in the West Bank village of Ein al-Duyuk near Jericho. Local residents report that these destructive activities are carried out with the direct protection of Israeli soldiers. Families affected by these actions accuse the Israeli government of complicity, as the ongoing displacement continues without any legal justification.

title: Autism and war: Gaza families grapple with destruction and loss
english: The ongoing conflict in Gaza is severely affecting autistic children like 16-year-old Ahmed Hatem al-Mahabeel, who are struggling with the loss of their routines, schools, and essential support services. Frequent explosions cause these children extreme sensory distress and panic, leading to serious behavioral setbacks and self-harm. In addition to psychological trauma, many are suffering from malnutrition and limited medical care, leaving families desperate for opportunities to seek rehabilitation abroad.

oromo: Waraanni Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru daa'imman autism qaban kan akka Ahmed Hatem al-Mahabeel miidhaa hamaa irraan ga'aa jira. title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue aimed at addressing long-standing political tensions, but representatives from the Somali Region are concerned about its potential impact. While participants are discussing state structure, Somali leaders worry that any move to reform the 1995 constitution could weaken their rights to self-determination and regional autonomy. Many in the region argue that the current federal system is flawed by poor implementation rather than by its core legal framework, and they fear the process might lead to increased centralization at their expense.

title: Why have several nations raised red flags over Indian farm exports?
english: Several countries, including Japan, China, and members of the European Union, have recently restricted Indian agricultural exports due to concerns over quality and safety standards. Japan specifically suspended mango imports after inspectors found flaws in the sterilization and certification processes at a key facility. These trade barriers create significant economic challenges for Indian farmers, who are already struggling with climate-related crop losses and rising shipping costs.

title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine has sent proposals to US to end war with Russia
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that his government has submitted new peace proposals to the United States to help conclude the ongoing conflict with Russia. He urged Washington to boost Ukraine's air defense capabilities and exert more pressure on Moscow to discourage the continuation of hostilities. Furthermore, Zelenskyy warned that Russia intends to use upcoming parliamentary elections as a justification to launch a massive new military mobilization later this year.

title: Iranian attacks reportedly target several areas in Iraq's Erbil
english: Iranian military forces have launched a series of drone and missile strikes against various locations within Erbil, Iraq. The attacks reportedly hit multiple districts, including Soran, Khalifan, and Harir. Regional news outlets are currently monitoring the situation as these strikes represent a significant escalation in the area.

title: Israeli attacks in south Lebanon continue, several injured
english: Military operations by Israel are persisting in southern Lebanon, where a drone strike recently injured multiple individuals. Additional heavy blasts were heard in the areas of Haddatha and Beit Yahoun. Authorities have not yet provided specific information regarding total casualties or the extent of physical destruction.

title: Libya power company says attack on Zawiya caused major outage
english: Libya’s national electricity provider reported a major power blackout in the southern Zawiya region following a deliberate attack on a local substation. The facility has suffered extensive damage due to frequent assaults, forcing the company to remove its repair crews for safety reasons. Consequently, officials have warned that these ongoing security threats will likely prolong the time needed to restore electricity to the affected areas.
