title: Houthi attacks in Yemen's Marib, Mocha left 'dozens killed and injured', military spokesman says
english: Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks against military installations in Marib and Mocha, Yemen. According to a Houthi spokesperson, these strikes resulted in numerous deaths and injuries, including among Saudi-affiliated personnel. The group stated that the operation was specifically directed at military targets associated with Saudi Arabia.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ እና ሞቻ ከተሞች በሚገኙ ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ ጥቃቱ ሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሚደግፉ ኃይሎችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የበርካታ ሰዎችን ህይወት መቅጠፉንና ሌሎች ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሱን ተናግረዋል። ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከል የሳዑዲ ወታደሮችም እንደሚገኙበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Houthii bakkeewwan waraanaa Maariib fi Mochaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa misa'elaa fi dooniiwwan ofiin balali'aniin raawwataniiru. Dubbi himaan waraana Houthii akka jedhutti, haleellaan kun humnoota Sa'udii wajjin hariiroo qaban kan kaayyeeffate yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu ajjeeseera akkasumas miiidhaa irra ga'eera. Miidhaa irra ga'e keessattis lammiileen Sa'udii akka jiran ibsameera.

title: Trump says military aircraft he flew on last month faced 'greater risk'
english: Donald Trump stated that he faced significant danger while traveling on a military aircraft after leaving Turkey secretly last month. He believes this specific plane was a prime target for potential attackers due to his presence on board. Reports suggest this clandestine flight occurred in response to credible threats regarding an Iranian assassination plot.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ባለፈው ወር ከቱርክ በድብቅ በወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ሲጓዙ ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደገጠማቸው ተናግረዋል። በእርሳቸው መገኘት ምክንያት ያ አውሮፕላን ለጥቃት ሰለባ የመሆን ዕድሉ ከፍተኛ እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። ይህ ሚስጥራዊ ጉዞ የተደረገው ኢራን በእርሳቸው ላይ የግድያ ሙከራ ለማድረግ ማቀዷን ተከትሎ እንደሆነ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Doonaald Traamp ji'a darbe Turkey irraa xiyyaara waraanaan yeroo icitiidhaan deemanitti balaa guddaa keessa akka turan ibsaniiru. Xiyyaarichi isaanii keessa waan turaniif, qaamota biroo biratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa akka argate fi kan qabamuuf yaalamu akka ture amanu. Adeemsi icitiidhaan gochaa turan kunis, shira ajjeechaa Iraaniin qindaa'e jedhamee sodaatame irraa kan madde akka ta'e gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Baby Shark Boy set to make K-pop debut
english: Park Geon-roung, who appeared as a child in the record-breaking Baby Shark music video, is now seventeen years old and preparing for a career in K-pop. He is working with Pinkfong, the entertainment company responsible for his initial viral success, to launch his music career. It remains to be seen if he can replicate his previous global popularity in the competitive Korean music industry.
amharic: በታዋቂው የቤቢ ሻርክ የሙዚቃ ቪዲዮ በልጅነቱ የታየው ፓርክ ጌኦን-ሮንግ፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት የ17 ዓመት ወጣት ሆኗል። ወጣቱ የኬ-ፖፕ ዘፋኝ ለመሆን በመዘጋጀት ላይ ሲሆን፣ ከቀድሞው አዘጋጅ ድርጅት ከፒንክፎንግ ጋር በመተባበር የሙዚቃ ጉዞውን እየጀመረ ነው። በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በነበረው ዝና የሙዚቃ ስራው ምን ያህል ተቀባይነት እንደሚያገኝ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Park Geon-roung kan fiilmii muuziqaa 'Baby Shark' kan baay'ee beekame irratti ijoollummaa isaa hirmaate, amma waggaa 17 ta'eera. Innis guddina muuziqaa 'K-pop' keessatti hirmaachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Dhaabbata 'Pinkfong' jedhamu waliin ta'uun hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, muuziqaan isaa milkaa'ina inni kanaan dura argate argachuu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu kan ilaallamu ta'a.

title: Can Trump keep his ‘irritation’ with Netanyahu in check?
english: Tensions are rising between Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu due to their conflicting views on Gaza peace plans. It remains uncertain whether this dispute is a minor policy disagreement or a more serious fracture in their political relationship. Observers are questioning if Trump can maintain composure regarding these differences as their strategic alignment faces new challenges.
amharic: በዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና በእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ መካከል በጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ላይ ባላቸው ልዩነት ሳቢያ አለመግባባት እየተፈጠረ ነው። ይህ መካረር በፖሊሲ ላይ የተመሠረተ ጊዜያዊ አለመግባባት ወይስ በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል የተፈጠረ ጥልቅ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት መሆኑ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም። ትራምፕ በጉዳዩ ላይ ያላቸውን ብስጭት መቆጣጠር ይችሉ እንደሆነ እና የሁለቱ መሪዎች ግንኙነት ወደፊት ምን እንደሚመስል ብዙዎች እየተጠራጠሩ ነው።
oromo: Donald Trumpifi ministirri muummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora nagaa Gaazaarratti yaada garaa garuun qabaachuun isaanii wal-dhabdee keessa akka galan taasiseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun rakkoo siyaasaa gadi fagoo ta'e ykn yaada marii irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu isaa adda baasuun ammayyuu rakkisaadha. Trump garaa garummaa kana irratti obsa qabaachuu danda'uufi dhiisuu isaanii akkasumas hariiroon isaanii gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu irratti gaaffiin hedduun ka'aa jira.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions continue as UN warns West Bank at breaking point
english: Israeli forces have intensified their military operations in the occupied West Bank, conducting multiple arrests and destroying numerous Palestinian homes and facilities. The United Nations has raised concerns that the situation in the territory has reached a critical breaking point due to these ongoing actions and increasing settler violence. Authorities continue to implement controversial demolition policies against the families of Palestinians involved in conflicts, leaving many residents displaced.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻውን በማጠናከር በበርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እስር የፈጸመ ሲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን መኖሪያ ቤቶችና ንብረቶች አፍርሷል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አካባቢው ከፍተኛ ቀውስ ውስጥ እንደገባ በማስጠንቀቅ በግጭቱ እና በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ምክንያት ሁኔታው ሊፈነዳ እንደሚችል ገልጿል። እስራኤል ከጥቃት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል የፍልስጤማውያን ቤቶችን የማፍረስ ፖሊሲዋን በመቀጠሏ ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eel naannoo West Bank keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa jabeessuun, namoota hedduu hidhaa fi manneen jireenyaa fi qabeenya Falasxinootaa mancaasuu itti fufaniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haalli naannichaa sadarkaa hamaa irra gahuu isaa fi miidhaan manneen jireenyaa akkasumas haleellaan warra biyya isaanii irraa buqqa'anii dhufanii (settlers) haala jiru daran hammaachisuu isaa ibseera. Israa'eel qondaaltoota Falasxiin waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumanii turan jedhamanii kan shakakamanii maatiiwwan isaanii irratti manneen diiguu itti fuftee waan jirtuuf, namoonni hedduu buqqa'uun isaanii gabaasameera.

title: Did Trump flee an Iranian assassination plot on a catering truck?
english: Reports suggest that former President Donald Trump was moved into a catering truck to secretly switch aircraft while departing a NATO summit in Ankara. This precaution was allegedly taken due to concerns regarding a potential bomb plot against him. Trump has stated that the decision to change planes was handled by the Secret Service.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአንካራ የኔቶ ስብሰባ ሲመለሱ በቦምብ ጥቃት ሊፈጸምባቸው ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ ከሌላ አውሮፕላን ወደ ሌላ ለመቀየር በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና ውስጥ ተደብቀው እንደነበር ተነግሯል። ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው የአውሮፕላን መቀየር ውሳኔው ሙሉ በሙሉ በሚስጥር አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች (Secret Service) የተወሰደ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp gubaa'ii NeeToo (NATO) Ankaaraatti godhame booda yeroo deebi'an, karoora boombii irratti xiyyeeffate tokkoon walqabatee xiyyaara jijjiiruuf konkolaataa nyaata fe'u keessa dhokachuun isaanii gabaafameera. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, xiyyaara jijjiiruun kun murtoo 'Siikreet Sarviisii' (Secret Service) tiin raawwatame dha.

title: Trump says secret plane switch ‘up to the Secret Service’
english: Donald Trump stated that the Secret Service was responsible for a discreet change of aircraft following a NATO summit in Turkey. Reports indicate that he had to board a different plane using a catering vehicle to avoid potential risks. This move allegedly occurred due to concerns regarding a possible Iranian assassination plot.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቱርክ የኔቶ ጉባኤ ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ የአውሮፕላን ለውጥ ያደረጉት በምስጢራዊ አገልግሎት (Secret Service) ትእዛዝ መሆኑን ገለጹ። እንደ ዘገባዎቹ ከሆነ፣ ኢራን አነጣጠረችብኝ በሚል ስጋት ምክንያት፣ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በምግብ ማቅረቢያ መኪና ተጠቅመው ወደ ሌላ አውሮፕላን እንዲሸጋገሩ ተደርጓል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል የተባለውን የደህንነት ስጋት ለመከላከል ነው።
oromo: Donald Trump erga gubaa'ii NATO kan Turkey irratti xumuramee booda, jijjiirraa xiyyaaraa kan godhe ajaja Secret Service tiin ta'uu ibse. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, sodaannoo hidhata Iran irraa dhufuun, Trump xiyyaara biraa gahuuf konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun fayyadamuu isaa ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame sodaa yakka ajjeechaa kan irra jiru ta'uu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Drone strikes power station near Libya’s largest oil refinery
english: A drone recently hit a power plant located in the city of Zawiya, Libya. This facility is situated close to the nation’s primary active oil refinery. Because the refinery has faced repeated attacks lately, authorities are now thinking about closing it down.
amharic: አንድ ድሮን በሊቢያ ዛዊያ ከተማ በሚገኝ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሷል። ይህ ጣቢያ የአገሪቱ ትልቁ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ አጠገብ የሚገኝ ነው። ማጣሪያው በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ስላጋጠሙት መንግስት ስራውን ለማቆም እያሰበ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaaraan malee ooftuu (drone) magaala Liibiyaa Zaawiyaatti argamu buufata anniisaa ibsaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwate. Buufanni kun bakka warshaan baasii boba'aa guddaan biyyattii itti argamu sanatti dhihoo dha. Warshichi guyyoota darban keessa haleellaa deddeebi'amee irra gahaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan hojii warshicha dhaabuu irratti mari'achaa jira.

title: Trump says he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
english: Former President Donald Trump confirmed that he secretly switched planes after a NATO summit in Turkey due to a potential security threat. U.S. officials reportedly received intelligence regarding a credible risk of an Iranian missile attack on the president's aircraft. To ensure his safety, the Secret Service utilized a decoy plane and moved Trump to a military jet using a catering truck, keeping the maneuver hidden from most staff and journalists on board.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቱርክ በተካሄደው የኔቶ ጉባኤ ማጠናቀቂያ ላይ ሊደርስባቸው የነበረውን ስጋት በመፍራት በድብቅ አውሮፕላን መቀየራቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በፕሬዝዳንቱ አውሮፕላን ላይ ሊቃጣ የሚችል የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ስጋት መኖሩን በመጠራጠራቸው ይህ እርምጃ መወሰዱ ተገልጿል። ለደህንነታቸው ሲባል የአሜሪካ የደህንነት ተቋም አባላት ፕሬዝዳንቱን በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና በመጠቀም ወደ ሌላ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን በማዘዋወር ከጋዜጠኞች እና ከሰራተኞች በተሰወረ መንገድ እንዲጓዙ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp, walga'ii Naatoo erga xumuranii booda doorsisa nageenyaa mudachuu danda'u tokkoon kan ka'e, xiyyaara isaan ittiin imalan dhoksaadhaan jijjiiruu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Qondaalonni Ameerikaa, xiyyaara pireezidaantichaa irratti weerarri mishaayilii Iran irraa dhufuu danda'u jiraachuu isaa odeeffannoo argachuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa. Nageenya isaanii eeguuf, gareen ittisaa isaa xiyyaara sobaa tokko fayyadamanii fi konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun Pireezidaanticha xiyyaara waraanaa biraatti jijjiiruudhaan, hojjettootaa fi gaazexeessitoota irraa dhoksuun bakka biraatti akka geessaman godhaniiru.

title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
english: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon successfully maintained his position after winning a confidence vote called to address internal doubts about his leadership. His administration has faced growing pressure due to a weak economy, rising unemployment, and a series of controversial public remarks. Despite these setbacks and declining poll numbers, Luxon insists his party remains unified and committed to succeeding in the upcoming November election.
amharic: የኒውዚላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስቶፈር ሉክሰን ስለ አመራር ብቃታቸው የተነሳውን ጥርጣሬ ተከትሎ በተደረገው የምክር ቤት እምነት የማግኘት ድምጽ አሸንፈው በስልጣን ላይ መቆየት ችለዋል። መንግስታቸው በኢኮኖሚ ድክመት፣ በስራ አጥነት መጨመር እና በአንዳንድ አወዛጋቢ ንግግሮቻቸው ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቋል። እነዚህ ችግሮች እና የህዝብ ድጋፍ መቀነስ ቢኖርም፣ ሉክሰን ፓርቲያቸው በአንድነት የቆመ እና በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ለማሸነፍ ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Niwuu Ziilaand Kiristoofar Luksaniin, shakkii gaggeessummaa isaa irratti ka'e hordofee sagalee amantii itti kenname injifachuun bakka isaa eeggachuu danda'eera. Guddinni dinagdee hir'achuu, hojii dhabdummaan dabaluu fi yaada inni hawaasa irratti dubbateen walqabatee mormiin guddaan mootummaa isaa irratti ka'aa ture. Rakkoolee fi fudhatamni isaa gadi bu'uu isaatiin ala, Luksaniin paartiin isaa tokkummaan akka jiru fi filannoo ji'a Sadaasaa dhufu keessatti injifachuuf murteeffatanii akka ka'an ibseera.

title: Dozens dead and missing after ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
english: An overloaded ferry sank in Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba, resulting in at least 15 deaths and 27 people still unaccounted for. Rescue teams managed to save 77 passengers who were transported to a nearby island. Search efforts remain ongoing to locate the missing individuals.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ ከመጠን በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን የጫነ ጀልባ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 15 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 27 ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አይታወቅም። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞች 77 ተሳፋሪዎችን ማዳን የቻሉ ሲሆን የተረፉትም በአቅራቢያው ወደሚገኝ ደሴት ተወስደዋል። የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ሥራው አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ziimbaabwee keessatti markabni namoota baay'ee fe'atee ture haroowwan Kaaribaa keessatti gombifamuun, namoonni 15 ol du'aniiru, 27 immoo bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsa namootaa namoota 77 oolchuun gara daa'imman sanaatti erganii jiru. Hojii namoota bade barbaaduus ammaaf itti fufaa jira.

title: Iran holds firm on Hormuz conditions as Pakistan’s Naqvi visits Tehran
english: Iran's top security official, Mohsen Rezaei, has declared that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States ends its military campaigns and blockades, releases frozen assets, and supports a regional ceasefire. These firm conditions were reiterated during a visit by Pakistan's interior minister to Tehran as diplomatic efforts to resolve the ongoing conflict continue. Meanwhile, President Trump has indicated uncertainty about the path forward, alternating between the possibility of a deal and threats of further pressure on Iran.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ባለስልጣን ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ እንደገና ከመከፈቱ በፊት አሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዋን እና ማዕቀቦቿን ማቆም፣ የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን መልቀቅ እና በጋዛና በሊባኖስ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን መደገፍ እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አቋም የፓኪስታን የውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በቴህራን ጉብኝት ባደረጉበት ወቅት የተገለጸ ሲሆን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ የሽምግልና ጥረቶችም ቀጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ በማዳከም ወይም ተጨማሪ ጫና በመፍጠር መካከል እንደሚዋዥቁ ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iraan, Mohsen Rezaei, hanga Ameerikaan duula waraanaa fi daangaa sana irratti qabdu dhaabdu, qabeenya Iraan qabame gadi dhiistu, akkasumas ce'umsa waraanaa guutuu biyya lafaa fi naannichaa (Gaza fi Libaanoos) kabajjuutti, daandiin Hormuz akka hin banamne dubbataniiru. Haala cimaa kana kan ibsan yoo ta'u, ergamtootni Paakistaan karaa dippiloomaasiin rakkoo kana furuuf gara Teheran imaluun marii taasisaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Prezidaant Traamp Iraan irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee gochuun ykn tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuun gidduutti murtoo irratti wal dhabaa jiraachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Stronghold of Syrian revolution celebrates Assad’s death sentence
english: Residents of Idlib, a key center for the Syrian opposition, recently held public celebrations following a court ruling. The judicial decision handed down death sentences to former leader Bashar al-Assad and other officials for atrocities committed during the nation's civil war. This development marks a significant symbolic moment for the region that led the uprising against the Assad family's five-decade rule.
amharic: የሶሪያ ተቃዋሚዎች ማዕከል በሆነችው ኢድሊብ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በሽር አል-አሳድ የሞት ፍርድ እንደተፈረደባቸው ሲሰሙ ደስታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ አሳድን እና ሌሎች የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናትን ለስልጣን ዘመናቸው በሶሪያ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት ለፈጸሙት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት የአሳድን ቤተሰብ የአምስት አስርት ዓመታት የግዛት ዘመን ላስቆመው እንቅስቃሴ ትልቅ ትርጉም ያለው ድል ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Buufata mormitoota Siiriyaa kan taate Idliib keessatti, jiraattonni pirezidaantii duraanii Bashaar al-Asaad irratti murtiin du'aa darbuu isaa erga dhaga'anii booda gammachuu isaanii ibsataniiru. Mana maree murtichaa kanneen yeroo waraana Siiriyaa keessatti yakka raawwataniif itti gaafatamtoota turan irratti adabbii cimaa kana murteesse. Murtiin kun maatii Asaad waggoota shantamii sadiif biyyattii bulchaa turan irratti kan xumura godhe ta'uun isaa iddoo kanaaf hiika guddaa qaba.

title: On the ground in Cali, Colombia’s worst-hit city after the quake
english: Following a powerful earthquake, the city of Cali, Colombia, is facing a severe crisis as the death toll continues to rise. Local residents and volunteers are working tirelessly to search through the ruins of collapsed buildings for survivors. The situation remains critical as rescue efforts persist in the hardest-hit areas of the country's third-largest city.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ከተማ ካሊ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የብዙ ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን የሟቾች ቁጥርም እየጨመረ ይገኛል። በከተማዋ ፍርስራሾች ውስጥ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ በጎ ፈቃደኞች ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በኮሎምቢያ ሦስተኛዋ ትልቅ ከተማ የሆነችው ካሊ፣ በአደጋው ክፉኛ በመጎዳቷ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa magaalaa Kaalii keessatti sochiin lafaa cimaan erga mudatee booda, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabalaa jira. Magaalattii keessatti, namoonni fedhiin hojjetan diigamuu manneenii keessatti lubbuun namoota hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Magaalaa sadooffaa Kolombiyaa taate kana keessatti haalli jiru baay'ee yaaddessaa dha.

title: Zambia to vote as economic hardship tests government reforms
english: Zambians are heading to the polls to vote in a general election that serves as a referendum on the government’s economic performance. While officials highlight successes like debt restructuring and international policy reforms, many citizens remain frustrated by the high cost of food, fuel, and electricity. Voters will ultimately decide if these macroeconomic improvements have positively impacted their daily lives and household financial stability.
amharic: የዛምቢያ ህዝብ በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ አፈጻጸም ላይ ወሳኝ ውሳኔ ለመስጠት ወደ ምርጫ ጣቢያዎች እያመሩ ነው። መንግስት የዕዳ ማሻሻያ እና የኢኮኖሚ ለውጦችን እንደ ስኬት ቢቆጥርም፣ በሌላ በኩል የኑሮ ውድነት እና የምግብ፣ የነዳጅ እንዲሁም የኤሌክትሪክ ዋጋ መናር በዜጎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅእኖ ፈጥሯል። በመሆኑም መራጮች እነዚህ የመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ለውጦች በተግባር የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸውን እንዳሻሻሉ በመመዘን ድምፃቸውን ይሰጣሉ።
oromo: Uummanni Zaambiyaa hojiilee diinagdee mootummaan hojjete irratti murtoo kennuuf gara sagalee kennuutti deemaa jiru. Mootummaan jijjiirama diinagdee fi hir’ina liqii akka milkaa’inaatti kan dhiyeessu ta’us, lammiileen baay’een gatii midhaan nyaataa, boba’aa fi elektirikii dabaluun jireenya irratti dhiibbaa uumuutti gungumachaa jiru. Kanaafuu, filattoonni jijjiiramonni diinagdee kunniin jireenya isaanii guyyuu keessatti jijjiirama dhugaa fiduu isaanii ilaaluun murtoo isaanii dabarsu.

title: Pentagon admits to killing 153 civilians last year in Yemen: Report
english: The Pentagon has officially informed Congress that American military operations against Houthi forces in Yemen last year resulted in the deaths of 153 civilians and left 243 others injured. The report highlights several specific deadly strikes that occurred during April, including a major incident at Ras Isa port. Officials also noted that investigations are still ongoing regarding at least 15 additional cases involving civilian casualties.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ባለስልጣናት ባለፈው አመት በየመን በሁቲዎች ላይ ባደረጉት ወታደራዊ ጥቃት 153 ንፁሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውን እና 243 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን ለኮንግረስ አረጋግጠዋል። በሪፖርቱ መሰረት፣ በኤፕሪል ወር ብቻ በሶስት ዋና ዋና ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት ጠፍቷል፤ ከእነዚህም መካከል በራስ ኢሳ ወደብ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ይገኝበታል። በተጨማሪም፣ ፔንታጎን ከዚህ ጋር በተያያዘ ሌሎች 15 ጉዳዮች አሁንም እየተጣሩ መሆናቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Pentagoniin gabaasa mana maree biyyattii qaqqabsiiseen, bara darbe Yemen keessatti loltoota Huthitti tarkaanfii fudhateen namoonni nagaa 153 du’anii 243 immoo madaa’uu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Gabaasichi akka ibsutti, miidhaan guddaan kun ji’a Ebla keessa kan qaqqabe yoo ta’u, keessattuu rukuttaa buufata doonii Raas Isaa irratti raawwatameen lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbeera. Kana malees, qorannoon dhimmoota biraa 15 irratti ammas itti fufaa akka jiru Pentagoniin beeksiseera.

title: US in ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz, Trump says
english: Former President Donald Trump recently asserted that the United States maintains complete authority over the Strait of Hormuz. He expressed a deep lack of trust in Iran while describing the ongoing diplomatic situation with Tehran as stable. According to him, American naval strength ensures that the U.S. remains the sole power in control of this critical maritime route.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት ተናግረዋል። ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግንኙነት ሲገልጹ፣ በቴህራን ላይ እምነት እንደሌላቸው ገልጸው አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል። አሜሪካ ባላት የባህር ኃይል አቅም፣ ይህንን ወሳኝ የውሃ መስመር ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠሯን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Amerikaa duraanii Donald Traamp, Amerikaan balbala galaana Hormuz irratti guutummaatti to'annoo akka qabdu ibsan. Isaan haala ammayyaa kana ilaalchisee garaa garummaa yaadaa qabanis, walitti dhufeenyi Iran waliin jiru tasgabbaa'aa akka jiru dubbataniiru. Humni galaana Amerikaa cimaa waan ta'eef, karaa daandii galaana kanaa to'achuun isaan qofa akka ta'e mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Qatar condemns Colombia’s backing of Israeli claims over occupied Golan Heights
english: Qatar has officially criticized Colombia for acknowledging Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights. The Qatari government maintains that this area is occupied Arab territory and argues that such recognition violates international law. Officials in Doha warned that supporting Israel's claim creates a significant barrier to establishing long-term peace in the region.
amharic: ኳታር ኮሎምቢያ የጎላን ኮረብታዎች የእስራኤል ግዛት ናቸው ብላ በመቀበሏ ተቃውሞዋን በይፋ ገልጻለች። የኳታር መንግስት ይህ ቦታ የተያዘ የአረብ ግዛት እንደሆነ አቋሙን የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ እንዲህ አይነት እውቅና መስጠት የአለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። በዶሃ የሚገኙ ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤልን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ መደገፍ ለክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Qatar mootummaan Kolombiyaa daangaa Golan kan Israa'eliin bulfamu ta'uu isaa beekamtii kennuun isaa akka isaan morman ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Qatar lafti kun kan biyyoota Arabaa akka ta'e fi beekamtii akkasii kennuun seera idil-addunyaa faallessu akka ta'e dubbatti. Itti gaafatamtoonni Doohaa deeggarsa akkasii kennuun nagaa naannichaa buusuuf gufuu guddaa ta'a jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
english: President Trump recently used a decoy plane and a catering truck to secretly switch aircraft following intelligence reports of an Iranian missile threat against Air Force One. This move highlights the intense and personal nature of the conflict between Trump and Iran, which has included previous assassination plots and US-led military strikes. While security experts note that such precautions are sometimes necessary in war zones, the unusual method of his travel underscores ongoing fears for the president’s safety.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በአየር ኃይል አንድ አውሮፕላን ላይ ሊሰነዘር የሚችል የኢራን ሚሳኤል ጥቃት ስጋት መኖሩን ተከትሎ፣ አውሮፕላናቸውን በድብቅ ቀይረዋል። የፕሬዝዳንቱ የደህንነት ቡድን ለጉዞው የማታለያ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም ትራምፕን በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና ውስጥ በመደበቅ ከአንድ አውሮፕላን ወደ ሌላ እንዲዛወሩ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በፕሬዝዳንቱ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ምን ያህል የግል እና አደገኛ እንደሆነ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የደህንነት ስጋቱም ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ያመላክታል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp yeroo dhihoo kana xiyyaarri 'Air Force One' haleellaa misaa'elaa Iraan irraa itti yaadamee jiraachuu ibsuun, xiyyaara isaa icitiidhaan jijjiirrateera. Gareen nageenyaa isaanii mala ispoortii fayyadamuun, pireezidaanticha konkolaataa nyaata fe'u keessatti dhoksudhaan xiyyaara gara biraatti akka jijjiirran godhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun walitti bu'iinsa pireezidaantichaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru akkam akka dhuunfaa fi sodaachisaa ta'e kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, yaaddoon nageenyaa irratti qabanis hangam akka olaanaa ta'e mul'isa.

title: N Korea launches ballistic missile as S Korea, US plan military drills
english: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the Sea of Japan, marking its second weapons test in less than a week. This launch coincides with preparations by South Korea and the United States for their upcoming joint military exercises scheduled to begin on August 17. Analysts view these actions as a typical response from Pyongyang to signal its opposition to the planned defense drills.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በሳምንት ውስጥ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ወደ ጃፓን ባህር አስወንጭፋለች። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው ደቡብ ኮሪያ እና አሜሪካ ኦገስት 17 ሊጀምሩት ላቀዱት የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ይህንን የሰሜን ኮሪያ እርምጃ የታቀደውን ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በመቃወም የምታሳየው ምላሽ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Koreen Kaabaa torban tokko hin guunne keessatti yeroo lammaffaaf xiyyara gosa balistikii gara galaana Jaappaaniitti gadi lakkifteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo Koriyaan Kibbaa fi Ameerikaan leenjii waraanaa gamtaa waggaa isaanii Hagayya 17 eegaluuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, gochi kun mormii Pyoongyaang leenjii waraanaa isaanirratti qabdu ibsuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Iran war live: US fires missiles at cargo ship violating Iran blockade
english: The United States military used Hellfire missiles to disable a Panamanian cargo ship that refused to stop while heading toward an Iranian port. Tensions remain high as Iran insists it will keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until the US ends its military actions, lifts its blockade, and releases frozen assets. Meanwhile, diplomatic efforts involving Qatar and Oman are currently underway to negotiate the future of shipping routes in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ወደ ኢራን ወደብ ሲጓዝ የነበረ እና ማስጠንቀቂያውን ችላ ያለ የፓናማ የጭነት መርከብን በሁለት ሚሳኤሎች መትተው አቁመዋል። ኢራን የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እስካልቆመ ድረስ እና የታገዱ ንብረቶቿ እስካልተለቀቁ ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ወሽመጥ እንደተዘጋ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቃለች። በአሁኑ ወቅት የኳታር እና የኦማን አደላዳይነት የባህር ማጓጓዣ መስመሩን ለመክፈት ድርድሮች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa doonii fe'umsaa kan Panamaan galchoofte, gara buufata doonii Iraanitti imalaa yeroo turte fi akeekkachiisa didde, maseelii lamaan rukutuun dhaabsiseera. Iraan hanga Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa dhaabdu, uggura kaastu fi qabeenya ishee qabame gadhiiftutti, bakki dhangala'aa Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u ibsiteetti. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, Qatar fi Omaan giddu galeessummaa ta'uun dhimma daandii galaanaarratti mariin gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: Cargo ship in flames after Houthi attack in Bab al-Mandeb strait
english: An Egyptian-owned cargo ship caught fire after being struck in the Bab al-Mandeb strait by suspected Houthi rebels. The attack reportedly resulted in the deaths of four crew members. If verified, these would be the first fatalities caused by Houthi strikes on commercial vessels since the current regional conflict began.
amharic: በባቢ አል-ማንደብ የባህር ወሽመጥ የግብፅ የጭነት መርከብ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ደርሶባት በእሳት ተያያዘች። ጥቃቱ በአራት የመርከቧ ሠራተኞች ሕይወት ማለፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል ተብሏል። ይህ መረጃ ከተረጋገጠ፣ ግጭቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲዎች ከተሰነዘረ ጥቃት የደረሰ የመጀመሪያው የሰው ሕይወት መጥፋት ይሆናል።
oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa kan Gibxi tokko, daandii galaana Bab al-Mandeb keessatti haleellaa garee Huutii jedhamuun erga rukutamee booda ibiddaan gubateera. Haleellaa kanaanis hojjettoonni markittii afur du'uu gabaasameera. Oduun kun yoo mirkanaa'e, waldhabdee yeroo ammaa kana keessatti duuti yeroo jalqabaaf haleellaa Huutiin markaboota daldalaa irra ga'e ta'a.

title: Israel and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations after years of severed ties
english: Israel and Venezuela have officially resumed diplomatic relations after a 17-year break. This change follows a shift in Venezuela's leadership under acting President Delcy Rodriguez, who has moved the country closer to the United States. Both nations have now established a system to provide essential consular services to their citizens.
amharic: እስራኤል እና ቬንዙዌላ ለ17 ዓመታት ተቋርጦ የነበረውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን በይፋ እንደገና ጀምረዋል። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው በጊዜያዊቷ ፕሬዝዳንት ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ስር ቬንዙዌላ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ማጠናከሯን ተከትሎ ነው። አገራቱ ለዜጎቻቸው አስፈላጊ የቆንስላ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት የሚያስችል համባበር መፍጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Israa'el fi Veenzuweelaan waggaa 17 booda hariiroo diippiloomaasii isaanii irra deebiin diriirsuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe pirezidaantii yeroo kan ta'an Delcii Rodriigeez jalatti Veenzuweelaan gara Ameerikaatti dhihaachuu ishee hordofeeti. Biyyoonni lamaanuu amma lammiilee isaaniif tajaajila koonsilaa barbaachisaa ta'e kennuuf waliigaltee irra ga'aniiru.

title: Israeli forces attack agricultural land in Syria, set up military checkpoint
english: On Tuesday, Israeli military forces launched three shells at farmland near the village of Hamidiya in the Quneitra region of Syria. Additionally, troops established a temporary military checkpoint in the nearby town of Kudna. These actions mark a continuation of Israeli military activity within Syrian territory.
amharic: ባለፈው ማክሰኞ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ኩኒትራ ግዛት በሚገኝ የግብርና መሬት ላይ ሶስት ጥይቶችን ተኩሰዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ወታደሮቹ በኩድና አካባቢ ጊዜያዊ ወታደራዊ መቆጣጠሪያ ጣቢያ አቋቁመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል በኩል በሶሪያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚደረገውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe, waraanni Israa'el naannoo Quneitra kan Suuriyaatti argamu qonnaa Hamidiyaatti dhukaasa meeshaa waraanaa sadii geggeessaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni kun magaalaa Kudna jedhamtu keessatti bakka to'annoo waraanaa yeroo dhaabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qindoomina waraanni Israa'el biyya Suuriyaa keessatti taasisaa jiru kan mul'isudha.

title: These seaside apartments were a ghost city - then police say scammers moved in
english: Malaysia's Forest City, a massive $100 billion project meant to house 700,000 people, has largely failed and remains nearly vacant. Taking advantage of the empty space, criminal groups recently turned dozens of these apartments into hubs for international cryptocurrency and romance scams. Authorities have since raided these locations, arresting over 300 individuals and seizing a significant amount of digital equipment used for illegal activities.
amharic: የማሌዢያዋ 'ፎረስት ሲቲ' የተባለችው ግዙፍ የ100 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ፕሮጀክት፣ 700 ሺህ ነዋሪዎችን ለማስተናገድ ታቅዶ የነበረ ቢሆንም በአሁኑ ወቅት ባዶ ቀርታለች። ይህንን ባዶነት በመጠቀም ወንጀለኞች በርካታ አፓርትመንቶችን በመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ የዲጂታል ገንዘብ እና የፍቅር ግንኙነት ማጭበርበሪያ ማዕከላት አድርገዋቸው ነበር። የሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ ባደረገው ኦፕሬሽን ከ300 በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን ለማጭበርበሪያነት ያገለግሉ የነበሩ በርካታ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሣሪያዎችንም ተቆጣጥሯል።
oromo: Magaalaan 'Forest City' jedhamtu kan Maaleezhiyaatti argamtu fi namoota 700,000 qabachuu qabduu, hojiin ishee waan hin milkoofneef amma gaddaafi duwwaa taateetti. Gareewwan yakka raawwatan, magaalattiin nama hin qabne kana fayyadamuun, gamoowwan ishee keessatti bakka maallaqa dijitaalaa fi hariiroo jaalalaa sobaan itti raawwatan bananii turan. Poolisiin biyyattii tarkaanfii fudhateen namoota 300 ol to'annoo jala oolche akkasumas meeshaalee elektirooniksii yakka sanaaf itti fayyadamaa turan hedduu harka isaanii galfataniiru.

title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors after deadly earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, causing widespread destruction and the deaths of at least 254 people. Rescue crews and volunteers are currently working around the clock to find survivors trapped under collapsed buildings in cities like Cali and Pereira. Thousands of homes have been damaged, and there is urgent concern for many individuals, including children, who remain missing in the debris.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተ ኃይለኛ 7.4 መጠን ያለው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 254 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና በጎ ፈቃደኞች በካሊ እና በፔሬራ ከተሞች የፈራረሱ ሕንፃዎችን በማፈራረስ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና ብዙ ሰዎች፣ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ፣ ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ተጠምደው በመሆናቸው የነፍስ አድን ስራው ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uun hanga 7.4 gahuun lubbuun namoota 254 ol akka darbu taasiseera. Ogeeyyonni gargaarsaa fi namoonni fedhiin hojjatan magaalaawwan akka Cali fi Pereira keessatti manneen diigaman keessa warra lubbuun jiran barbaaduuf guyyaa fi halkan hojjachaa jiru. Manneen kumaan lakkaawwaman diigamuun isaa fi ijoollee dabalatee namoonni hedduun caccabaa manaa jala hafuun isaanii gargaarsicha ariifachiisaa taasiseera.

title: Turkey condems Colombia's support for Israeli Golan Heights occupation
english: Turkey has officially criticized Colombia for acknowledging Israeli control over the Golan Heights, a region that is internationally recognized as part of Syria. This decision follows similar backlash from several other nations, including Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Iraq. The Turkish government emphasized that this move undermines Syrian sovereignty and has urged the international community to work toward ending the occupation.
amharic: ቱርክ ኮሎምቢያ በጎላን ኮረብታ ላይ የእስራኤልን የበላይነት እውቅና መስጠቷን በይፋ አውግዛለች፤ ይህ አካባቢ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የሶሪያ ግዛት እንደሆነ ይታወቃል። ይህ የቱርክ ውሳኔ እንደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ኳታር እና ኢራቅ ካሉ ሌሎች ሀገራት ከተሰነዘረ ተመሳሳይ ተቃውሞ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው። የቱርክ መንግስት ይህ ድርጊት የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት እንደሚጋፋ በመግለጽ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን ወረራ ለማስቆም የበኩሉን እንዲወጣ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Turkiin Kolombiyaan naannoo Golan Heights irratti aangoo Israa'el beekamtii kennuushee balaaleffatteetti; naannichi kunis sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti kan biyyattii Sooriyaa akka ta'e beekama. Murtii kanaan dura biyyoonni akka Saudii Arabiyaa, Qatar fi Iraaq balaaleffannaa walfakkaatu dhageessisanii turan. Mootummaan Turkii tarkaanfichi kun abbaa biyyummaa Sooriyaa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsuun, hawaasni idil-addunyaa qabiyyee kana xumursiisuuf qooda akka fudhatu gaafateera.

title: US rights groups sue Trump administration over ICC sanctions
english: Four prominent human rights organizations have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration regarding sanctions imposed on the International Criminal Court. The groups argue that these measures hinder their legal and humanitarian work and violate their constitutional rights by punishing those who interact with the court. These sanctions were introduced following investigations into high-level Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza.
amharic: አራት ታዋቂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ በተጣለው ማዕቀብ ላይ በመቃወም የትራምፕ አስተዳደርን ከሰዋል። ድርጅቶቹ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ህጋዊ እና ሰብአዊ ስራዎቻቸውን እንደሚገድቡ እና ከፍርድ ቤቱ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሰዎች በመቅጣት ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን እንደሚጥሱ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ማዕቀብ የተጣለው ፍርድ ቤቱ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በተለይም በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ በጋዛ የተፈጸሙ ጦርነቶችን በመመርመሩ ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Jaarmayoonni mirga namoomaa afur beekamoon, mootummaan Trump adaba mana murtiitti idil-addunyaa (ICC) irratti buuse mormuun himata bananiiru. Jaarmayoonni kun adabni kun hojii isaanii kan guutuufi mirga isaanii kan sarbu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Adabni kun kan dhufeyis ICCn qorannoo yakka waraanaa gaggeessuu isaa hordofee hoogganoota Israa'el irratti, keessattuu muummicha ministeeraa Beenyaamiin Neetanyaahuu irratti kan xiyyeeffatedha.
